secciones.descripcion: Paso final de la certificación grupal: autoevaluación del ISH + auditoría interna por la CO + auditoría externa por el Organismo de Certificación (ISCC 201-5 §4.3). La auditoría interna es anual y maneja la corrección de no-conformidades.

campos.label: ¿El ISH realizó la autoevaluación y entregó su autodeclaración a la CO?
campos.help: Not all ISH within the considered region need to be certified. Only ISH that are willing to get ISCC certified are subject to certification. If an ISH wants to get certified, he must sign a self-declaration and provide it to the CO (step 1).

campos.label: ¿La CO realiza la auditoría interna y la repite anualmente?
campos.help: Based on the self-declarations, the CO will do internal audits (step 2). The internal audit covers the ISCC requirements for ISH and must be repeated annually.

campos.label: ¿En la primera auditoría interna se verificaron TODOS los ISH que entregaron autodeclaración?
campos.help: Within the 1st internal audit, all ISH who have provided a self-declaration need to be checked.

campos.label: ¿El auditor interno compara las coordenadas de campo del ISH con los resultados del análisis GRAS (Principio 1)?
campos.help: In order to verify compliance with ISCC Principle 1, the internal auditor has to compare the ISH field coordinates with the GRAS analysis results. For verifying compliance with ISCC Principles 2 - 6, the internal auditor has to follow the ISCC audit procedures for ISH on-field.

campos.label: ¿El auditor (interno y externo) usa los procedimientos de auditoría ISCC para ISH y CO?
campos.help: ISCC provides audit checklists (so-called audit procedures) for both, the ISH and the CO. The auditor must complete the audit procedures that are based on the requirements laid down in the ISCC System Documents, to prove evidence of compliance of a System User with the requirements. These procedures... should also be used by CO to prepare for the audit as well as for the internal audits.

campos.label: ¿Las no-conformidades se corrigen dentro de los 40 días, so pena de exclusión del grupo?
campos.help: If non-conformities are detected, corrective measures must be identified. The internal audit cannot be closed as long as those corrective measures have not been implemented. If corrective actions have not been implemented within 40 days or if the ISH refuses to implement corrective actions, he must be excluded from ISH group certification.

campos.label: ¿El auditor firma el reporte de auditoría y la CO marca al ISH como miembro ISCC-conforme?
campos.help: If the internal audit was successful, the auditor signs the audit report and hands it to the CO. The CO will mark the ISH as new ISCC-compliant group member. FFBs delivered by this ISH can now be considered as ISCC compliant.

campos.label: ¿Se realiza la auditoría externa por un Organismo de Certificación (CB) con auditor capacitado en ISH?
campos.help: As soon as the internal audit has been conducted, the CO and the ISH group can be subject to an external audit conducted by a Certification Body (CB). Auditors can only conduct ISH audits after the successful participation in an ISH training for CBs.

campos.label: ¿El certificado tiene validez de 12 meses con auditoría de certificación anual?
campos.help: Since ISCC certificates are valid for 12 months, a certification audit is conducted once a year. Certificates are valid over a period of twelve months as stated on the certificate. The validity of a certificate starts on the date as indicated on the certificate (not the date of publication on the ISCC website).

campos.label: ¿El operador declara todos los esquemas de certificación en que participa y entrega los reportes de auditoría previos?
campos.help: Economic operators have to declare the names of all certification schemes they participate in and have to provide the auditor with all relevant information, including the audit reports and chain of custody information, such as mass balances, for verification.

campos.label: Reporte(s) de auditoría interna / autodeclaraciones
campos.help: The auditor has to get access to any audit reports from previous audits under this standard.

secciones.descripcion: Reglas de muestreo de los ISH del grupo y gestión de riesgo (ISCC 201-5 §4.3 y referencia a ISCC 204 / 206). El tamaño de muestra depende de si hubo altas de nuevos ISH en el último año.

campos.label: ¿Desde la 2.ª auditoría interna se verifica al menos el 25% de los ISH (si no se sumaron nuevos en el último año)?
campos.help: From the 2nd internal audit on, 25% of all ISH must be checked (if no new ISH were added within the last year).

campos.label: ¿Los FFB de ISH recién sumados NO se venden como sostenibles hasta pasar auditoría interna?
campos.help: If new ISH are added and provide self-declarations during the year, FFBs from those ISH cannot be sold as sustainable as long as they have not been subject to an internal audit.

campos.label: ¿Una muestra de los ISH miembros del grupo se somete a la auditoría externa por el CB?
campos.help: A CO is audited with respect to the management system, traceability and chain of custody, as well as GHG emissions. A sample of all ISH that are members of the group is subject to an audit. The procedure of ISH sampling and verification is further described in ISCC 206 "Group Certification".

campos.label: ¿Hay gestión de riesgo con procedimientos e indicadores definidos por ISCC (scorecard, evaluación continua)?
campos.help: Risk management is an integral part of all operations and decisions in the ISCC system. In order to securely fulfil the requirements of the certification system in a highly credible and reliable way, ISCC defines procedures and specific indicators for risk assessment and management. For ISH specific risks have been identified. These include e.g. the risks of storing and applying plant protection products and the compliance with ISCC Principle 1.

campos.label: ¿Se admite que el CB o ISCC realicen auditorías de vigilancia (anunciadas o no) ante sospecha razonable?
campos.help: In case of reasonable suspicion CBs are entitled to conduct announced or unannounced surveillance audits at any time during the certificate's period of validity. If necessary, ISCC is entitled to request CBs to conduct surveillance audits at any time during the certificate's period of validity.

secciones.titulo: Principio 1 — Protección de la tierra (verificación GRAS)
secciones.descripcion: Protección de tierras de alto valor de biodiversidad o alto stock de carbono (ISCC 202, Principio 1). En ISH el cumplimiento se verifica vía análisis GRAS de la tierra, no en campo; la responsabilidad se transfiere a la CO.

campos.label: ¿La tierra NO es de alto valor de biodiversidad ni de alto stock de carbono (bosque primario, turbera, humedal, HCV, etc.)?
campos.help: Principle 1: Protection of land with high biodiversity value or high carbon stock. This includes primary forests and other wooded land of native species, highly biodiverse grassland, peatland, wetland, continuously forested areas, areas designated for the protection of rare, threatened or endangered ecosystems or species, as well as high conservation value (HCV) areas.

campos.label: ¿No hubo conversión de tierra de alto carbono o alta biodiversidad después de enero de 2008 (fecha de corte)?
campos.help: The cut-off date for land use change according to Principle 1 is January 2008. This means that every farm or plantation, where conversion of land with high carbon stock or high biodiversity took place after January 2008 is excluded from ISCC certification.

campos.label: ¿El cumplimiento del Principio 1 se verifica mediante análisis GRAS de la tierra del ISH (sin cambio de uso del suelo detectado)?
campos.help: The verification with ISCC Principle 1 is ensured via a GRAS assessment of the ISH land. Only ISH, for which the GRAS assessment did not detect land use change, can participate in the ISH group certification. In order to ease verification of compliance for ISH, compliance with Principle 1 is checked via a GRAS analysis. Only ISH that have been identified to lie within regions that are compliant with Principle 1 can participate in the ISH group certification.

campos.label: ¿Las coordenadas del ISH caen en zona "Go" (no en zona crítica / "No Go") según el análisis GRAS?
campos.help: With the help of the ISH Data Management System, the CO can check whether the coordinates of the ISH are within a critical area according to the GRAS analysis. If the coordinates of an ISH are within the critical area, the ISH cannot take part in ISCC certification and has to be excluded from the ISH group certification program. ISH, who, according to GRAS, converted land after January 2008, cannot provide self-declarations or data. Those self-declarations cannot be accepted.

campos.label: Coordenadas / polígono de la tierra del ISH (para verificación GRAS)
campos.help: ISCC follows a landscape approach to ensure compliance with Principle 1. Therefore, ISCC conducts a land use change analysis with the Global Risk Assessment Services (GRAS) tool for the respective ISH land.

secciones.titulo: Principio 2 — Producción ambientalmente responsable (suelo, agua, aire) y manejo de agroquímicos
secciones.descripcion: Producción ambientalmente responsable para proteger suelo, agua y aire (ISCC 202, Principio 2). El almacenamiento, mezcla, aplicación y disposición de agroquímicos están TRANSFERIDOS a la CO o a un subcontratista: el ISH no debe ejecutar esas tareas.

campos.label: ¿La producción es ambientalmente responsable para proteger suelo, agua y aire?
campos.help: Principle 2: Environmentally responsible production to protect soil, water and air.

campos.label: ¿El ISH NO realiza el almacenamiento, mezcla, aplicación ni disposición de agroquímicos (lo asume la CO o un subcontratista)?
campos.help: The storage, mixing, application and disposal of chemicals such as plant protection products should not be performed by the ISH. Thus, it is in the responsibility of the CO or a subcontractor to perform the following tasks and reach compliance with the respective ISCC criteria.

campos.label: ¿La CO/subcontratista prohíbe los químicos del Convenio de Estocolmo y evita los de WHO 1a/1b y del Anexo III de Rotterdam? (2.4.1)
campos.help: Prohibition of certain chemicals of the Stockholm Convention and avoidance of chemicals listed in in WHO1a and 1b as well as the Annex III of the Rotterdam Convention (Criterion 2.4.1).

campos.label: ¿Se aplican exclusivamente productos fitosanitarios registrados en el país de uso para el cultivo objetivo? (2.4.2)
campos.help: Exclusive application of plant protection products that are registered in the country of use for target crop (2.4.2).

campos.label: ¿Se respetan las restricciones de uso de los productos fitosanitarios y la legitimidad de la semilla? (2.4.3, 2.4.4)
campos.help: Restrictions on the use of plant protection products (2.4.3). Legitimization of seed (2.4.4).

campos.label: ¿Se conservan las facturas de los productos fitosanitarios? (2.4.5)
campos.help: Invoices of plant protection products (2.4.5).

campos.label: ¿El personal que maneja productos fitosanitarios es competente, los aplica adecuadamente y con equipo calibrado? (2.6.1, 2.6.2, 2.6.3)
campos.help: Competence of staff dealing with plant protection products (2.6.1). Application of plant protection products is done appropriately (2.6.2), and application equipment is calibrated (2.6.3).

campos.label: ¿Se llevan registros de la aplicación de productos fitosanitarios? (2.6.4)
campos.help: Records of application (2.6.4).

campos.label: ¿Hay instalaciones adecuadas de medición/mezcla y disposición de obsoletos, sobrantes y aguas de lavado? (2.7.1, 2.7.2, 2.7.3)
campos.help: Appropriate measuring and mixing facilities (2.7.1). Maintenance and disposal of obsolete plant protection products (2.7.2) and surplus mixes and tank washings (2.7.3).

campos.label: ¿Se gestionan el reúso y la disposición de los envases vacíos? (2.7.4, 2.7.5, 2.7.7)
campos.help: Re-use and disposal of empty containers (2.7.4, 2.7.5, 2.7.7).

campos.label: ¿Hay almacenamiento adecuado de fertilizantes (minerales), fitosanitarios y derivados de petróleo, con inventario de stock? (2.8.1-2.8.6)
campos.help: Appropriate storage of (mineral) fertilizers (2.8.1, 2.8.2), plant protection products (2.8.3, 2.8.4) and mineral oil products (2.8.6). Product inventory for stock (2.8.5).

campos.label: Evidencia del almacenamiento de agroquímicos (CO / subcontratista)
campos.help: All ISCC requirements referring to storage, handling and disposal of plant protection products must be fulfilled by the CO.

secciones.descripcion: Condiciones de trabajo seguras (ISCC 202, Principio 3). Para el ISH solo aplica si emplea a alguien. Las tareas transferidas a la CO/subcontratista conllevan los requisitos de SST.

campos.label: ¿Se garantizan condiciones de trabajo seguras?
campos.help: Principle 3: Safe working conditions.

campos.label: ¿Se reconoce que para el ISH los requisitos de SST solo aplican si emplea a alguien (familiares o trabajadores migrantes)?
campos.help: For ISH the requirements of Principles 3 and 4 referring to employees' rights and safe working conditions for workers are only applicable, if the ISH employs somebody, e.g. relatives or migrant workers.

campos.label: ¿Hay registros de capacitación y certificados de competencia del personal? (3.1.1, 3.1.2)
campos.help: Records for training (3.1.1) and certificates of competence (3.1.2).

campos.label: ¿Existe una política escrita de salud, seguridad e higiene? (3.2.1)
campos.help: Written health, safety and hygiene policy (3.2.1).

campos.label: ¿Se provee ropa de protección adecuada (EPP)? (3.2.2)
campos.help: Suitable protective clothing (3.2.2).

campos.label: ¿Hay señales de advertencia para peligros potenciales? (3.2.3)
campos.help: Warning signs for potential hazards (3.2.3).

campos.label: ¿Hay procedimiento y equipo para accidentes e instalaciones de descontaminación? (3.2.4, 3.2.5)
campos.help: Accident procedure and equipment (3.2.4) and contamination facilities (3.2.5).

campos.label: Evidencia de EPP / instalaciones de seguridad
campos.help: As the above activities are transferred to the CO or a subcontractor, also requirements of Principle 4 on employees' rights are applicable for them.

secciones.titulo: Principio 4 — Derechos humanos, laborales y de la tierra; relaciones comunitarias
secciones.descripcion: Cumplimiento de derechos humanos, laborales y de la tierra y relaciones comunitarias responsables (ISCC 202, Principio 4). Para el ISH los requisitos de derechos de los empleados solo aplican si emplea a alguien; aplican plenamente a la CO/subcontratista.

campos.label: ¿Se cumplen los derechos humanos, laborales y de la tierra y hay relaciones comunitarias responsables?
campos.help: Principle 4: Compliance with human, labour and land rights and responsible community relations.

campos.label: ¿Los requisitos de derechos de los empleados (Principio 4) se aplican a la CO/subcontratista que asume las tareas transferidas?
campos.help: As the above activities are transferred to the CO or a subcontractor, also requirements of Principle 4 on employees' rights are applicable for them.

campos.label: ¿Se reconoce que para el ISH el Principio 4 (derechos de los empleados) solo aplica si emplea a alguien?
campos.help: For ISH the requirements of Principles 3 and 4 referring to employees' rights and safe working conditions for workers are only applicable, if the ISH employs somebody, e.g. relatives or migrant workers.

secciones.titulo: Principio 5 — Cumplimiento de leyes y tratados internacionales
secciones.descripcion: Cumplimiento de las leyes aplicables y de los tratados internacionales relevantes (ISCC 202, Principio 5).

campos.label: ¿Se cumplen las leyes aplicables y los tratados internacionales relevantes?
campos.help: Principle 5: Compliance with applicable laws and relevant international treaties.

secciones.titulo: Principio 6 — Buenas prácticas de gestión y mejora continua
secciones.descripcion: Buenas prácticas de gestión y compromiso con la mejora continua (ISCC 202, Principio 6).

campos.label: ¿Hay buenas prácticas de gestión y compromiso con la mejora continua?
campos.help: Principle 6: Good management practices and commitment to continuous improvement.

campos.label: ¿Existe un programa de capacitación que asegura la mejora gradual del ISH?
campos.help: In order to ensure a gradual improvement of ISH, a training program on certification was set up by ISCC ("Train-the-trainer"). All ISH participating in the ISCC certification, need to participate in such a training.

secciones.descripcion: Trazabilidad de los materiales sostenibles a lo largo de la cadena y método de cadena de custodia (ISCC 201-5 §3.3.2, referencia a ISCC 203). Dos métodos posibles: balance de masa o segregación física.

campos.label: ¿Es posible rastrear los productos sostenibles hacia adelante y hacia atrás en toda la cadena, del origen a la entrega final?
campos.help: Traceability and chain of custody cover two basic requirements: The possibility of tracing sustainable products back and forth throughout the supply chain from origin to final delivery.

campos.label: ¿Se asigna la información específica del producto (características de sostenibilidad) a los lotes de material sostenible?
campos.help: The possibility of assigning product specific information to consignments (batches) of sustainable materials and products. Sustainability characteristics according to this standard include the raw material, country of origin of the raw material, quantities, information on GHG emissions, and the claim "ISCC compliant" or "EU RED compliant" (if applicable).

campos.label: Método de cadena de custodia aplicado
campos.help: To correctly assign all relevant information to the physical material according to this standard, two chain of custody methods can be applied: mass balance or physical segregation. Under the mass balance method, physical mixing of sustainable and non-sustainable material is allowed. Under physical segregation, sustainable material has to be kept separated from non-sustainable material.

campos.label: ¿La CO tiene un sistema de gestión que asegura la implementación de los requisitos de trazabilidad y cadena de custodia?
campos.help: Specific requirements are laid down in ISCC Document 203 "Traceability and Chain of Custody". Document 203 also includes requirements for a company's management system to ensure the implementation of all necessary requirements.

campos.label: ¿Se emiten declaraciones de sostenibilidad (sustainability declarations) con las características de sostenibilidad correctas?
campos.help: Sustainability characteristics according to this standard include the raw material, country of origin of the raw material, quantities, information on GHG emissions, and the claim "ISCC compliant" or "EU RED compliant" (if applicable).

secciones.titulo: Emisiones de gases de efecto invernadero (GEI / ISCC 205)
secciones.descripcion: Requisitos de emisiones de gases de efecto invernadero (ISCC 201-5 §3.3.3, referencia a ISCC 205). Para ISH se usa el valor por defecto desagregado de cultivo de FFB en lugar de un cálculo individual.

campos.label: ¿Se usa el valor por defecto desagregado para el cultivo de FFB en lugar de un cálculo individual de GEI por ISH?
campos.help: As an alternative to do an individual GHG calculation for each and every ISH, the use of a disaggregated default value for cultivation of FFBs was determined to be the most suitable option. It can be combined with other disaggregated default values (i.e. those for processing and for transport & distribution) or with actual values.

campos.label: Para mercado UE (ISCC EU): ¿la declaración de sostenibilidad indica "Use of disaggregated default values for cultivation/extraction"?
campos.help: Where the FFBs are sold under an ISCC EU certificate to the EU biofuels market, the statement "Use of disaggregated default values for cultivation/extraction" must be made on the sustainability declaration.

campos.label: Para mercado no-UE: ¿se declara el valor por defecto desagregado 123.04 kg CO2eq por tonelada de FFB?
campos.help: Where the end-market is Non-EU biofuels (and the material is not sold under an ISCC EU certificate), the disaggregated default value 123.04 kg CO2eq per ton of FFB can be stated on the sustainability declaration.

campos.label: ¿Se reconoce que los requisitos de GEI aplican a todos los elementos relevantes de la cadena, de la producción a la distribución del producto final?
campos.help: The requirements on GHG emissions apply to all relevant supply chain elements from feedstock production to the distribution of the final product, including cultivation, collection and conversion processes, as well as the transport and distribution of intermediate and final products. All further requirements to apply, calculate and verify the greenhouse gas emissions and emission savings are specified in the general ISCC Document 205 "Greenhouse Gas Emissions".

schemas.descripcion: Captura audit-grade de un proyecto de carbono ARR (forestación/reforestación) sobre una plantación FSC: identificación, línea base, adicionalidad, cuantificación de carbono (reservorios), permanencia, fugas, monitoreo (MRV) y salvaguardas/co-beneficios. Pensado para el piloto teca → ARR. El dato es del productor (farmer-owned); el crédito se vende con su consentimiento.
schemas.fuente_normativa: Estructura basada en las metodologías públicas ARR/A-R: Verra VCS (AR-ACM0003 / AR-AM tools de adicionalidad y línea base, AFOLU non-permanence risk tool), Plan Vivo Standard, Gold Standard for the Global Goals (A/R). MRV = Measurement/Reporting/Verification. Co-beneficio y cadena de custodia: FSC (ya LIVE en el catálogo).
schemas.disclaimer: PLANTILLA ESTRUCTURAL del motor MRV de carbono (frente lead #05). NO es una metodología registrada: los parámetros exactos (ecuaciones alométricas, factores de expansión de biomasa, % del buffer de no-permanencia, descuentos de fuga) deben tomarse de la METODOLOGÍA específica (VCS/Verra, Plan Vivo o Gold Standard) que elija el proyecto, y validarse con el VVB (Validation & Verification Body) antes de emitir créditos. La biomasa se mide (no se estima) con LiDAR (#04) / percepción remota (#08); ver el contrato de formato de biomasa.

secciones.descripcion: Datos del proyecto ARR, su anclaje FSC y el estándar de carbono destino.

campos.label: ID del proyecto de carbono
Productor / titular del crédito (farmer-owned)
campos.help: R21: el productor controla el dato del carbono y vende el crédito. Ancla a su identidad Capa 0 (cédula/RUC).

campos.label: Unidad de manejo forestal (vínculo FSC)
campos.help: Misma UMF del proyecto FSC. El inventario forestal FSC (ya LIVE) es el insumo del MRV.

campos.label: Especie
Superficie del proyecto
Polígono del área del proyecto
campos.help: Límite elegible del proyecto. El motor del visor valida la topología.

campos.label: Tipo de proyecto
campos.help: El piloto teca = ARR.

campos.label: Estándar de carbono destino
campos.help: Define los parámetros exactos (línea base, adicionalidad, buffer). Validar la metodología elegida con el VVB.

campos.label: Fecha de inicio del proyecto
Periodo de acreditación
campos.help: Típico ARR: 20–40 años. Lo fija la metodología.

secciones.descripcion: El escenario de carbono SIN el proyecto — contra el que se mide la remoción adicional.

campos.label: Uso del suelo antes del proyecto
campos.help: ARR exige tierra NO forestal por ≥10 años antes del proyecto (elegibilidad). Evidencia histórica (imágenes/registros).

campos.label: ¿La tierra cumple la elegibilidad ARR (no-forestal ≥10 años, evidenciado)?
campos.help: Verra/Gold Standard A/R: demostrar que la tierra no era bosque al inicio (imágenes satelitales históricas + registros de uso).

campos.label: Stock de carbono de la línea base
campos.help: Carbono que existiría sin proyecto (usualmente bajo en tierra degradada). La remoción del proyecto se descuenta de este baseline.

campos.label: ¿El escenario de línea base está justificado (no habría reforestación sin el proyecto)?
campos.help: El baseline debe ser conservador y realista: qué pasaría con la tierra sin el incentivo de carbono.

campos.label: Evidencia de la línea base (imágenes históricas, registros)

secciones.descripcion: ¿El proyecto ocurriría de todas formas SIN el financiamiento de carbono? Si sí, no es adicional.

campos.label: ¿Pasa el test regulatorio (la ley NO obliga ya a reforestar esta área)?
campos.help: Adicionalidad: la actividad no es requerida por ley/regulación vigente.

campos.label: ¿Pasa el test financiero (no es rentable sin el ingreso de carbono)?
campos.help: Análisis de inversión: sin la venta de créditos, el proyecto no supera la barrera financiera (VAN/TIR insuficiente).

campos.label: ¿Existen barreras (técnicas, institucionales, de capital) que el carbono ayuda a superar?
campos.help: Barreras que impedirían el proyecto sin el incentivo de carbono.

campos.label: ¿NO es práctica común en la región (no se reforesta así por defecto)?
campos.help: Common practice test: la actividad no es ya generalizada en el contexto local.

campos.label: Evidencia de adicionalidad (análisis financiero, documentación de barreras)

secciones.descripcion: La remoción de CO₂ medida por reservorio. La biomasa viene del inventario LiDAR (#04) / percepción remota (#08).

campos.label: ¿La biomasa aérea se MIDE (LiDAR/percepción remota), no se estima?
campos.help: Dato de actividad audit-grade: DAP+altura por árbol → ecuación alométrica por especie → tCO2e (formato #04). Cada árbol = crop_individuals en Capa 0.

campos.label: Remoción total cuantificada del proyecto
campos.help: Suma sobre los reservorios incluidos. Unidad canónica del crédito = tCO2e.

campos.label: Reservorios incluidos
campos.help: La metodología define qué reservorios se contabilizan; los no medidos se asumen conservadoramente (0 o descuento).

campos.label: Ecuación alométrica / fuente
campos.help: Ecuación por especie (FAO u oficial). Debe estar documentada y ser apropiada para la especie/región.

campos.label: Incertidumbre de la cuantificación
campos.help: La incertidumbre alta genera un descuento conservador del crédito (la metodología lo penaliza).

secciones.descripcion: El carbono debe permanecer almacenado. Se descuenta un buffer por riesgo de reversión (incendio, plaga, tala).

campos.label: Nivel de riesgo de reversión
campos.help: Riesgos: incendio, plaga (Fusarium/otros), tala ilegal, eventos climáticos, abandono. El AFOLU Non-Permanence Risk Tool de Verra lo cuantifica.

campos.label: Aporte al buffer de no-permanencia
campos.help: Un % de los créditos va a un pool de buffer (seguro común) según el riesgo (típico 10–25%). NO se venden; cubren reversiones.

campos.label: ¿Hay plan de mitigación de reversión (cortafuegos, MIP, vigilancia)?
campos.help: Medidas para reducir el riesgo de pérdida del carbono almacenado.

campos.label: ¿Hay compromiso de longevidad (mantener el bosque el periodo acreditado)?
campos.help: El proyecto se compromete a mantener el almacenamiento durante el periodo de acreditación (y monitorear reversiones).

secciones.descripcion: Emisiones desplazadas fuera del área del proyecto por causa del proyecto. Se descuentan del crédito.

campos.label: ¿Se evaluó la fuga por desplazamiento de actividad (la actividad agrícola/ganadera se movió a otro lado)?
campos.help: Activity-shifting leakage: si reforestar la tierra empuja la actividad previa (pastoreo/cultivo) a otra área, esas emisiones se descuentan.

campos.label: ¿Se evaluó la fuga de mercado (efecto sobre la oferta/demanda de madera u otros)?
campos.help: Market leakage: efectos indirectos vía mercado.

campos.label: Descuento por fugas aplicado
campos.help: La metodología define el factor de descuento de fugas a restar de la remoción bruta.

campos.label: ¿Hay medidas de gestión de fugas (intensificación, alternativas para el productor)?

secciones.descripcion: Plan de medición/reporte/verificación periódico. Define cómo se confirma la remoción en el tiempo.

campos.label: ¿Existe un plan de monitoreo documentado?
campos.help: Define parámetros, métodos, frecuencia y responsables del monitoreo de la remoción y las reversiones.

campos.label: Métodos de medición
campos.help: LiDAR (preciso por árbol) + percepción remota (escala) se cruzan en Capa 0. Complementarios.

campos.label: Frecuencia de monitoreo
¿Los datos de monitoreo llevan la cadena de integridad audit-grade (inalterables)?
campos.help: Misma cadena de integridad del Encuestador: el dato es verificable para el VVB.

campos.label: ¿Verificación por un VVB (Validation & Verification Body) acreditado?
campos.help: Un tercero independiente valida y verifica antes de emitir créditos. El dato audit-grade reduce el costo/fricción de la verificación.

campos.label: Evidencia de monitoreo (informes, inventarios, ortofotos fechadas)

secciones.descripcion: Salvaguardas sociales/ambientales + co-beneficios (biodiversidad, comunidad, FSC). Consentimiento del productor.

campos.label: ¿El productor consintió la participación y la venta del crédito (farmer-owned)?
campos.help: R21: el productor controla su dato y decide; consentimiento informado y reparto de beneficios claro.

campos.label: ¿Se cumplen las salvaguardas sociales (sin desplazamiento, reparto justo de beneficios)?
campos.help: Detalle laboral/social se reusa del core (trabajadores/trabajo decente).

campos.label: ¿Hay co-beneficio de biodiversidad (especies nativas, conectividad)?
campos.help: Detalle de conservación se reusa del core (conservación/biodiversidad). Gold Standard/Plan Vivo valoran co-beneficios.

campos.label: ¿El área tiene FSC (manejo forestal sostenible verificado)?
campos.help: FSC (ya LIVE) es co-beneficio + cadena de custodia: el ARR sobre FSC es de baja fricción y alta credibilidad.

campos.label: Evidencia de salvaguardas/co-beneficios

schemas.titulo: GLOBAL G.A.P. - IFA Fruta y Verdura (P&C v6 GFS)
schemas.descripcion: Puntos de control y criterios oficiales IFA v6 GFS para Fruta y Verdura (banano), verbatim, con nivel + que revisa el auditor.
schemas.fuente_normativa: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA GFS Principles & Criteria for Fruit and Vegetables v6.0-GFS (Aug 2024)
schemas.disclaimer: Puntos de control y criterios transcritos VERBATIM del documento oficial de GLOBALG.A.P. (idioma original). Niveles oficiales (Major/Minor/Recommendation). El "que revisa el auditor" (verifica[]) y la evidencia se DERIVAN automaticamente del criterio oficial (reformateo accionable, pendiente de validar con auditor real). Para auditoria real, validar contra la version vigente y la Interpretacion Nacional aplicable.

campos.label: Existe un procedimiento para gestionar y controlar los documentos y registros.
campos.criterio: Documents and records affecting implementation of the requirements shall be managed and controlled. A documented procedure shall describe: - How documents and records are created, reviewed, approved, and updated - How reviews are undertaken and changes or amendments are made - How version updates take place - How relevant documentation is made available to relevant staff Documentation shall be: - Identified with an issue number and/or date and appropriately paginated - Sufficiently detailed - Reviewed periodically to demonstrate ongoing compliance with the relevant requirements - Assigned to relevant staff - Revised to incorporate relevant modifications of the standard or normative documents within the period given by GLOBALG.A.P. - Approved by authorized staff prior to distribution - Effectively rescinded when obsolete
verifica: Documents and records affecting implementation of the requirements shall be managed and controlled

A documented procedure shall describe: - How documents and records are created, reviewed, approved, and updated - How reviews are undertaken and changes or amendments are made - How version updates take place - How relevant documentation is made available to relevant staff Documentation shall be: - Identified with an issue number and/or date and appropriately paginated - Sufficiently detailed - Reviewed periodically to demonstrate ongoing compliance with the relevant requirements - Assigned to relevant staff - Revised to incorporate relevant modifications of the standard or normative documents within the period given by GLOBALG.A.P. - Approved by authorized staff prior to distribution - Effectively rescinded when obsolete

campos.label: Los registros para fines de auditoría están actualizados. Los registros se conservan durante un período mínimo de dos años, salvo que se requiera un período más largo.
campos.criterio: All records generated or kept by the producer for auditing purposes shall: - Be stored securely, readily accessible and kept up to date - Be retained for a minimum of two years, or longer if required by customers or prevailing regulations - Be valid and backed-up, if used in electronic format
verifica: All records generated or kept by the producer for auditing purposes shall: - Be stored securely, readily accessible and kept up to date - Be retained for a minimum of two years, or longer if required by customers or prevailing regulations - Be valid and backed-up, if used in electronic format

campos.label: El productor completa anualmente como mínimo una autoevaluación/auditoría interna conforme a la norma.
campos.criterio: The self-assessment/internal audit shall evaluate compliance, review implementation, and support identification of improvement opportunities. A program of site inspections ensures the site and equipment are maintained, in support of food safety. The frequency of inspections is based on assessed risk and type of activities. A documented self-assessment for individual producers or an internal farm and quality management system (QMS) audit for multisite producers with QMS and producer groups shall: - Occur at least once a year and before the certification body (CB) audit - Be completed by the producer, assigned worker, or consultant, and/or as part of a QMS - Include all applicable topics covered by the standard/scope, even those addressed using subcontractors (including harvest and postharvest activities) - Assess all applicable sites and products - Cover at least three months prior to the date of the initial certification body (CB) audit, or begin on the day of registration, whichever is longer - Reference full details of each area and all activities covered by the registration Self-assessments shall contain comments regarding the evidence observed for all not applicable and non-compliant Major Must and Minor Must principles and criteria. For internal farm audits, comments shall follow "GLOBALG.A.P. general regulations – Rules for producer groups and multisite producers with QMS." Where an individual record is missing, the respective principle addressing those records is not compliant. For example, if the date of application is missing on a single spray record, a non-conformance or non-compliance shall be issued against that principle.

campos.label: Se toman acciones correctivas eficaces para subsanar las no conformidades detectadas durante las autoevaluaciones/auditorías internas.
campos.criterio: Corrective actions shall be documented. Any necessary changes shall be implemented. Compliance with all applicable Major Musts and at least 95% of applicable Minor Musts is required.
verifica: Corrective actions shall be documented
Any necessary changes shall be implemented
Compliance with all applicable Major Musts and at least 95% of applicable Minor Musts is required

campos.label: Se documenta un plan de mejora continua.
campos.criterio: The producer shall evaluate the farming operation and identify improvements to be undertaken as assessed by the standard. These improvements shall be included in a longer-term plan covering up to three years. The continuous improvement plan shall consist of relevant self-defined targets and describe how progress toward each target will be monitored. The plan may include: - Description of improvement objective - Current status, with date of initial target establishment - Planned activity - Target outcome with estimated date of achievement

campos.label: Existe evidencia de que el plan de mejora continua se implementa.
campos.criterio: The implementation of identified points in the continuous improvement plan shall be supported by evidence. Evidence may include new procedures or policies, data sharing (to quantify changes), training, etc. The continuous improvement plan shall be supported by documented evidence. The evidence kept on file may include: - Actual outcome of efforts, with date of evaluation - Comments on why the effort was successful or not successful - If one or more of the goals are not reached, justification and description of further action - Sharing of relevant data with the GLOBALG.A.P. Secretariat

campos.label: Se definen las funciones y responsabilidades de los trabajadores cuyas tareas tienen un impacto en la implementación de la norma.
campos.criterio: Workers with assigned duties that affect food safety and the implementation of activities covered by the standard shall be identified, including: - Job function, responsibilities, and title - Position within organizational structure - Contact information - Alternate in case of absences One worker shall be clearly identifiable as responsible for workers' health, safety, and welfare.
verifica: Workers with assigned duties that affect food safety and the implementation of activities covered by the standard shall be identified, including: - Job function, responsibilities, and title - Position within organizational structure - Contact information - Alternate in case of absences One worker shall be clearly identifiable as responsible for workers' health, safety, and welfare

campos.label: Las personas responsables de la toma de decisiones técnicas sobre los insumos pueden demostrar su competencia.
campos.criterio: Individuals responsible for technical decisions regarding treatments (quantity and type of fertilizer, pre- and postharvest plant protection product (PPP) applications, both organic and inorganic, etc.) shall demonstrate competence in such topics. If the individual responsible for technical decisions is the producer, a designated worker, or a technical expert, their experience shall be complemented by current technical knowledge (access to technical literature, specific training attendance, active PPP applicator license, etc.). If the individual responsible for technical decisions is an external qualified adviser, technical competence shall be demonstrated by official qualifications or specific training attendance certificates.

campos.label: La capacitación de los trabajadores incluye las habilidades y competencias necesarias y está respaldada por registros.
campos.criterio: Workers shall be able to demonstrate competence in their assigned tasks. Tasks that shall require specific training include handling and/or administering of agricultural chemicals, disinfectants, plant protection products (PPPs), biocides, and/or other hazardous substances and operating of equipment.

campos.label: Se mantienen registros de todas las actividades de capacitación.
campos.criterio: Evidence of training includes attendance records, certificates, or other relevant qualifications. Subcontractors shall either be trained by the producer or be able to demonstrate competence through previous training or certification. Induction or refresher training shall be recorded. Training records relevant to the implementation of the standard and good agricultural practices shall include: - Date of training and duration - Topic(s) covered - Names of trainer(s) or training provider(s) - Names of trainee(s) (e.g., attendance list(s)) - Evidence of attendance (e.g., trainee signature)

campos.label: El productor asegura que las actividades subcontratadas cumplen con los principios y criterios de la norma que son pertinentes a los servicios prestados.
campos.criterio: Outsourced processes and/or the use of subcontractors are identified and controlled. The producer shall oversee the activities undertaken by the subcontractors to ensure compliance with the relevant principles and criteria in the standard. This applies to each activity and season in which at least one subcontractor is used. Evidence of compliance with relevant principles and criteria shall be collected by means of an assessment and shall be available during the certification body (CB) audit. If such an assessment is undertaken by a producer, evidence of compliance with the relevant principles and criteria shall be available. The subcontractor shall agree to such assessment by a producer where relevant to the standard. A GLOBALG.A.P. approved CB may assess the subcontractor and may issue a letter of conformance with the following information: - Date of assessment - Name of the CB - CB auditor name - Details of the subcontractor - List of the assessed principles and criteria Certificates issued to subcontractors for standards that are not officially approved by the GLOBALG.A.P. Secretariat are not valid evidence of compliance with the standard.

secciones.titulo: FV-GFS 5 - Specifications, Suppliers, And Stock Management

campos.label: Se dispone de especificaciones y procedimientos para los materiales y servicios que son pertinentes para la inocuidad alimentaria.
campos.criterio: A procedure shall be implemented and maintained for the control of suppliers of inputs and services that may introduce a food safety risk. The procedure shall include: - Evaluation, approval, and continued monitoring of suppliers - Procurement in emergency situations to ensure materials and services still conform to specifications - Availability of records of evaluations, investigations, and follow-up actions Specifications supporting the implementation of the standard and customer compliance shall be available. Specifications shall be reviewed annually or when changes occur, whichever is sooner. These changes may include the following, where relevant: - Supplier specifications for packaging (where applicable) - Allowable and acceptable licenses or qualifications for service providers (pest control contractors, laboratory services, etc.) - Descriptions of customer requirements - Defined specifications for raw materials Descriptions of how alternate suppliers will be evaluated in the event of emergency or supply chain disruptions shall also be available.
verifica: A procedure shall be implemented and maintained for the control of suppliers of inputs and services that may introduce a food safety risk

The procedure shall include: - Evaluation, approval, and continued monitoring of suppliers - Procurement in emergency situations to ensure materials and services still conform to specifications - Availability of records of evaluations, investigations, and follow-up actions Specifications supporting the implementation of the standard and customer compliance shall be available

campos.label: Existe un inventario para gestionar las existencias en el sitio.
campos.criterio: A stock inventory shall ensure that materials and products do not pose a risk to food safety and that those with limited shelf lives are used in the correct order. The inventories shall consider purchased materials (plant protection products (PPPs), ammonium fertilizer, etc.) and apply to both pre- and postharvest activities (e.g., chlorine tablets). Items considered to be stock may include cleaning agents, fertilizers, and PPPs. Monthly updates are not required, but a calculation of inventory shall occur within a month of any use or purchase. In months when there is no stock movement, there is no need to update the inventory. Where products are distributed by a central function, the records may be held by the quality management system (QMS).

campos.label: Todos los productos registrados son trazables hacia y desde la finca registrada donde se produjeron y manipularon (cuando corresponda).
campos.criterio: A documented identification and traceability system shall allow registered products to be traced back to the registered farm or supplier, or to the registered farms or suppliers of the Option 2 producer group, and traced forward to the immediate customer (one step forward and one step back). Harvest information shall link a batch or lot to the production records or the farms of specific producers. Product handling shall also be covered, where applicable. Records shall be available of the annual verification of the traceability system. This verification can occur through an actual recall and withdrawal or as part of a mock recall and withdrawal exercise.

secciones.titulo: FV-GFS 7 - Parallel Ownership, Traceability, And Segregation

campos.label: Existe un sistema eficaz para identificar todos los productos originados en procesos certificados por GLOBALG.A.P. y segregarlos de los productos originados en procesos no certificados.
campos.criterio: It shall be possible to identify all products originating from GLOBALG.A.P. certified production processes and to keep them separate from products originating from noncertified production processes.
verifica: It shall be possible to identify all products originating from GLOBALG.A.P. certified production processes and to keep them separate from products originating from noncertified production processes

campos.label: El Número GLOBALG.A.P. (GGN) se indica en todos los productos finales originados en procesos de producción certificados cuando se registra para propiedad paralela.
campos.criterio: Where the producer is registered for parallel ownership (i.e., where products originating from certified and noncertified production processes are owned in parallel by one legal entity), all products originating from certified production processes packed in final consumer packaging (either on the farm or after product handling) shall be identified with a GGN. It can be the GGN of the Option 2 producer group, the GGN of the producer group member, both GGNs, or the GGN of the Option 1 individual producer. The GGN shall not be used to label products originating from noncertified production processes.
verifica: Where the producer is registered for parallel ownership (i.e., where products originating from certified and noncertified production processes are owned in parallel by one legal entity), all products originating from certified production processes packed in final consumer packaging (either on the farm or after product handling) shall be identified with a GGN
It can be the GGN of the Option 2 producer group, the GGN of the producer group member, both GGNs, or the GGN of the Option 1 individual producer

campos.label: Existe una etapa de verificación final para asegurar el despacho correcto de los productos originados en procesos de producción certificados y no certificados.
campos.criterio: The check shall be documented to show that the products are correctly dispatched according to the certification status.
verifica: The check shall be documented to show that the products are correctly dispatched according to the certification status

campos.label: Los productos que se adquieren de diferentes fuentes están identificados.
campos.criterio: Procedures (appropriate for the scale of the operation) shall be established, documented, and maintained for identifying quantities of products originating from certified and, where applicable, noncertified production processes purchased from different sources (i.e., other producers or traders) for all registered products. Records shall include: - Product description - GLOBALG.A.P. certification status - Quantities of product(s) purchased - Supplier details - Copy of the GLOBALG.A.P. certificates, where applicable - Traceability data/codes related to the purchased products - Purchase orders and/or invoices received - List of approved suppliers
verifica: Procedures (appropriate for the scale of the operation) shall be established, documented, and maintained for identifying quantities of products originating from certified and, where applicable, noncertified production processes purchased from different sources (i.e., other producers or traders) for all registered products

Records shall include: - Product description - GLOBALG.A.P. certification status - Quantities of product(s) purchased - Supplier details - Copy of the GLOBALG.A.P. certificates, where applicable - Traceability data/codes related to the purchased products - Purchase orders and/or invoices received - List of approved suppliers

campos.label: Se dispone de registros de ventas de todas las cantidades vendidas de todos los productos registrados.
campos.criterio: Sales details of the quantities of products originating from certified and, where applicable, noncertified production processes shall be recorded for all registered products, with particular attention paid to quantities sold and descriptions provided. The documents shall demonstrate the consistent balance between the input and the output of products originating from certified and noncertified production processes.
verifica: Sales details of the quantities of products originating from certified and, where applicable, noncertified production processes shall be recorded for all registered products, with particular attention paid to quantities sold and descriptions provided
The documents shall demonstrate the consistent balance between the input and the output of products originating from certified and noncertified production processes

campos.label: Las cantidades (producidas, almacenadas y/o compradas) se registran y resumen para todos los productos.
campos.criterio: Quantities (including information on volumes or weight) of incoming (including purchased products), outgoing (including reject, waste, pulp, etc.), and stored products (both from certified and, where applicable, from noncertified production processes) shall be recorded and a summary maintained for all registered products, so as to facilitate the mass balance verification process, while accounting for industry acceptable gains and losses. The frequency of the mass balance verification shall be defined and be appropriate to the scale of the operation, but it shall be done at least annually for each product. Documents to demonstrate mass balance shall be clearly identified. If the certification body (CB) audit is done during the harvest season, mass balance data from last year's harvest may be reviewed. This shall be prepared prior to the CB audit. "N/A" is possible where a bulk product (e.g., potatoes sold to a buyer in bulk directly from the field) is handed from harvest directly to the buyer and/or where a product is harvested directly into containers from the field and shipped to customers. Justification of why mass balance is not applicable shall be given.

campos.label: Existen procedimientos documentados para gestionar la retirada y el retiro de productos del mercado, y dichos procedimientos se prueban anualmente.
campos.criterio: The producer shall have a documented procedure that identifies: - The types of events that may result in a recall and withdrawal - The persons responsible for making decisions on the possible recall and withdrawal - The mechanism for notifying the next step in the supply chain - The notification of relevant authorities when required - Steps taken to contact the certification body (CB), which in turn may contact the GLOBALG.A.P. Secretariat - The methods for reconciling stock The procedure shall be tested annually for effectiveness and the results of the mock recall shall be recorded (e.g., selecting a lot and demonstrating that it can be effectively traced forward to the customer). Actual communications of the mock recall to the clients are not necessary. An up-to-date list of telephone numbers and email addresses is sufficient. If an actual recall and withdrawal occurred during the past year, documentation of these may be provided for compliance.

campos.label: Se dispone de un procedimiento de reclamaciones relacionado con asuntos internos y externos cubiertos por la norma y se implementa.
campos.criterio: A documented complaint procedure shall be available to facilitate the recording and follow-up of all received complaints relating to issues covered by the standard and to record actions taken with respect to such complaints. If the producer is informed by a competent and/or local authority that they are under investigation and/or has received a sanction within the scope of the certification, the complaint procedure shall require the producer to notify the GLOBALG.A.P. Secretariat via the certification body (CB). In case of complaints related to the standard (food safety, workers' well-being, environmental protection, etc.) that can endanger the reputation and credibility of the GLOBALG.A.P. brand, the certificate holder shall inform the CB immediately. In the case of producer groups, the producer group members do not need a complete complaint procedure, but only the parts that are relevant to them. Workers shall be permitted to file complaints to their employer on topics covered under the standard, and such complaints shall be documented and addressed by the certificate holder.

campos.label: Los trabajadores están informados de sus derechos relacionados con la norma, y existe y se implementa un mecanismo de quejas mediante el cual los trabajadores pueden presentar reclamaciones de forma confidencial y sin temor a represalias.
campos.criterio: Workers shall be informed (in the predominant workforce language) of the general topics covered by the standard, of legal rights granted by prevailing regulations, and of their ability to file complaints to their employer. The producer shall have a mechanism to resolve the claims and complaints suitable to the size of the farm, type of workers, and working conditions. The mechanism shall be confidential and simple to use, and a description (i.e., where to file, how to file, time expected to solve the issue) shall be available to the workers all the time that they are present on the farm. (The description can consist of pictograms or signs in the predominant workforce language describing the mechanism.) Records of the filed complaints shall be kept and checked.

campos.label: Existen procedimientos para gestionar y manejar los productos no conformes.
campos.criterio: Documented procedures, including a hold-and-release process, shall be in place to prevent unintended use or delivery of nonconforming products. Products may be considered non-conforming because of food safety issues, quality issues, maximum residue limit exceedance(s), cross contamination issues, etc. Non-conforming products shall be identified during production and handling. Non-conforming products shall be segregated, appropriately handled, and potentially redirected to a suitable end use (processing, animal feed, etc.). If not redirected, the products shall be disposed of appropriately. The non-conforming product procedures shall also address the treatment of dropped product, as per the risk assessment. Products that pose a risk to food safety shall not be harvested or shall be discarded. Discarded products and waste materials shall be stored in clearly designated areas to avoid contamination of products. Signs shall be used to identify waste products, where appropriate. These areas shall be routinely cleaned and/or disinfected according to the cleaning schedule. Where the root cause is related to significant food safety reasons, the procedure in place shall be implemented and maintained for the determination and implementation of corrective actions. Such actions shall aim to eliminate the cause of a non-conformity to prevent reoccurrence.

campos.label: Los análisis de laboratorio se realizan de manera coherente con los requisitos del sector y las regulaciones vigentes.
campos.criterio: There shall be documented evidence that laboratories used to analyze parameters impacting food safety are operating in accordance with the requirements of ISO/IEC 17025. Analysis shall include water quality, plant protection product residues, environmental monitoring samples, and microbial, chemical, and physical contamination, as well as all other applicable tests. The laboratories shall show evidence of participation in proficiency tests or applicable certifications (e.g., the proficiency testing program provider FAPAS).

campos.label: Los equipos, herramientas y dispositivos son aptos para su propósito y reciben mantenimiento.
campos.criterio: Equipment, tools, and devices coming into contact with products shall be made of materials that are safe for contact with products (nontoxic) and designed and constructed to ensure that they can be cleaned, disinfected, and maintained to avoid contamination. Equipment, tools, and devices, even those not coming into direct contact with products (scales, plant protection product (PPP) or fertilizer application equipment, thermometers, pH meters, etc.), shall be identified, maintained, routinely verified, and, where applicable, calibrated at least annually. Calibration shall be traceable to a national or international standard or method. Equipment maintenance, calibration (where applicable), and repairs shall be documented. Maintenance activities shall not present risks to food safety, the environment, or workers. PPP sprayers: The calibration of PPP application machinery (automatic and nonautomatic) shall have been verified for correct operation within the last 12 months, and this verification shall be certified or documented either by participation in an official scheme (where it exists) or by having been carried out by a person who can demonstrate their competence. Irrigation/Fertigation equipment: At a minimum, annual maintenance records shall be kept for all methods of irrigation/fertigation machinery/techniques used.

At a minimum, annual maintenance records shall be kept for all methods of irrigation/fertigation machinery/techniques used

campos.label: Los equipos se almacenan de manera que se evite la contaminación del producto.
campos.criterio: Equipment (plant protection product (PPP) or fertilizer application equipment, harvesting equipment, wrapping machines, etc.) shall be stored in an appropriate way that prevents possible contamination of products or other materials that may come into contact with the edible portion of the harvested products.
verifica: Equipment (plant protection product (PPP) or fertilizer application equipment, harvesting equipment, wrapping machines, etc.) shall be stored in an appropriate way that prevents possible contamination of products or other materials that may come into contact with the edible portion of the harvested products

campos.label: Los vehículos y equipos utilizados para la carga, el transporte o el almacenamiento de los productos cosechados se limpian, mantienen y son apropiados para su uso.
campos.criterio: Vehicles and equipment used for loading, transport, or storage of harvested products shall be cleaned and maintained and stored to prevent product contamination (animal manure, fuel spills, etc.). Vehicles and equipment shall be suitable for the intended purpose and stored to minimize food safety risk.
verifica: Vehicles and equipment used for loading, transport, or storage of harvested products shall be cleaned and maintained and stored to prevent product contamination (animal manure, fuel spills, etc.)
Vehicles and equipment shall be suitable for the intended purpose and stored to minimize food safety risk

campos.label: El productor ha completado y firmado la declaración de política de inocuidad alimentaria.
campos.criterio: The producer's food safety policy declaration shall: - Support the existence of a food safety culture, consisting of communication, training, feedback from workers, and measurable food safety objectives - Be annually completed and signed by the producer/manager responsible for food safety - Indicate people whose activities impact food safety - Serve as documented evidence of commitment to continuous improvement, food safety culture, provision of resources, and adherence to relevant prevailing regulations - Serve as documented evidence of review by management of all elements of the food safety system, on an annual basis or whenever changes occur that impact food safety - Substantiate the self-assessment checklist (for Option 1 individual producers) - Be completed either by central management or on quality management system (QMS) level on behalf of Option 2 producer group members and Option 1 multisite producers with QMS
verifica: The producer's food safety policy declaration shall: - Support the existence of a food safety culture, consisting of communication, training, feedback from workers, and measurable food safety objectives - Be annually completed and signed by the producer/manager responsible for food safety - Indicate people whose activities impact food safety - Serve as documented evidence of commitment to continuous improvement, food safety culture, provision of resources, and adherence to relevant prevailing regulations - Serve as documented evidence of review by management of all elements of the food safety system, on an annual basis or whenever changes occur that impact food safety - Substantiate the self-assessment checklist (for Option 1 individual producers) - Be completed either by central management or on quality management system (QMS) level on behalf of Option 2 producer group members and Option 1 multisite producers with QMS

campos.label: Existe un sistema de defensa alimentaria para abordar los riesgos asociados con ataques malintencionados o contaminación.
campos.criterio: The system shall include: - A risk assessment to identify potential threats to the safety of products, taking into account risks from deliberate attempts to inflict contamination or damage - A documented food defense plan to specify the measures to control any risks identified in the risk assessment - Consideration of identification of tampering to the premises and products, monitoring of external storage and intake points, controlled access where relevant, receiving inputs from safe sources, and having available information for all employees and subcontractors - Worker, visitor, and subcontractor awareness of the need to support food defense measures, ensured through training, signs, pictograms, etc.
verifica: The system shall include: - A risk assessment to identify potential threats to the safety of products, taking into account risks from deliberate attempts to inflict contamination or damage - A documented food defense plan to specify the measures to control any risks identified in the risk assessment - Consideration of identification of tampering to the premises and products, monitoring of external storage and intake points, controlled access where relevant, receiving inputs from safe sources, and having available information for all employees and subcontractors - Worker, visitor, and subcontractor awareness of the need to support food defense measures, ensured through training, signs, pictograms, etc

campos.label: Existe un sistema para abordar los riesgos asociados con el fraude alimentario.
campos.criterio: The system shall include: - A risk assessment to identify potential threats to the safety of the product, taking into account risks from fraudulent or adulterated materials - A documented food fraud plan to specify the measures to control any risks identified in the risk assessment - Consideration shall be given to potential impacts of intentional inaccurate information associated with a product for economical gain - Where applicable, risks associated with counterfeit PPP, unauthorized propagation material, origin of packaging, use of approved suppliers, control over access to packaging shall be considered
verifica: The system shall include: - A risk assessment to identify potential threats to the safety of the product, taking into account risks from fraudulent or adulterated materials - A documented food fraud plan to specify the measures to control any risks identified in the risk assessment - Consideration shall be given to potential impacts of intentional inaccurate information associated with a product for economical gain - Where applicable, risks associated with counterfeit PPP, unauthorized propagation material, origin of packaging, use of approved suppliers, control over access to packaging shall be considered

campos.label: La palabra, la marca registrada y el código QR o logotipo de GLOBALG.A.P., así como el Número GLOBALG.A.P. (GGN), se utilizan de acuerdo con "Uso de las marcas registradas de GLOBALG.A.P.: política y directrices".
campos.criterio: The producer shall use the GLOBALG.A.P. word, trademark, and QR code or logo, as well as the GGN, Global Location Number (GLN), or sub-GLN according to "GLOBALG.A.P. trademarks use: Policy and guidelines." The GLOBALG.A.P. word, trademark, or logo shall never appear on the final product, on the consumer packaging, or at the point of sale. However, the certificate holder can use any and/or all in business-to-business communications. The GLOBALG.A.P. word, trademark, or logo cannot be in use during the initial (first ever) certification body (CB) audit because the producer does not yet have certification, and the producer cannot refer to GLOBALG.A.P. certification status before the first positive certification decision.

campos.label: La documentación de las transacciones incluye una referencia al estado GLOBALG.A.P. y al Número GLOBALG.A.P. (GGN).
campos.criterio: Delivery notes, sales invoices, and, where appropriate, other documentation related to sales of materials and products originating from certified production processes shall include the GGN of the certificate holder and a reference to the GLOBALG.A.P. certification status. This is not obligatory in internal documentation. Where the producer has a Global Location Number (GLN), this shall replace the GGN issued by the GLOBALG.A.P. Secretariat during the registration process. Positive identification of the certification status is sufficient on transaction documentation (e.g., "GLOBALG.A.P. certified [product name]"). Products originating from noncertified production processes do not need to be identified as "noncertified." Indication of the certification status is obligatory regardless of whether the product originating from a certified production process was sold as such or not. This cannot be checked during the initial (first ever) certification body (CB) audit because the producer does not yet have certification and the producer cannot reference the GLOBALG.A.P. certification status before the first positive certification decision. "N/A" only if there is an up-to-date and documented bilateral agreement available between the certificate holder and their direct buyer that all shipments contain only products originating from certified production processes.

campos.label: La finca cuenta con una evaluación de riesgos de higiene documentada.
campos.criterio: A documented hygiene risk assessment covering production, harvesting, and handling, as applicable, shall cover: - Physical, chemical, and microbiological contaminants, spillage of bodily fluids (vomiting, bleeding, etc.), and human transmissible diseases that are associated with the applicable products and processes - Workers, personal effects, equipment, clothing, packaging material, transport, vehicles, and product storage (including short-term storage on the farm) - The production environment, including design and layout for prevention of cross contamination and support of food safety - Measurement and monitoring of cleaning and hygiene activities
verifica: A documented hygiene risk assessment covering production, harvesting, and handling, as applicable, shall cover: - Physical, chemical, and microbiological contaminants, spillage of bodily fluids (vomiting, bleeding, etc.), and human transmissible diseases that are associated with the applicable products and processes - Workers, personal effects, equipment, clothing, packaging material, transport, vehicles, and product storage (including short-term storage on the farm) - The production environment, including design and layout for prevention of cross contamination and support of food safety - Measurement and monitoring of cleaning and hygiene activities

campos.label: Existen procedimientos de higiene documentados para minimizar los riesgos de inocuidad alimentaria.
campos.criterio: Hygiene procedures shall be aligned with the risk assessment and include applicable harvest and postharvest activities. Pictograms or signs in the predominant workforce language shall describe the appropriate hygiene measures for workers, visitors, and subcontractors. When protective equipment and clothing (smocks, aprons, sleeves, gloves, footwear, etc.) are required, they shall be provided by the employer and cleaned, maintained, and stored in a way that minimizes food safety risks. Hands shall be washed whenever they may be a source of contamination, including prior to the start of work and after using the toilet. The hygiene procedures shall address contamination of product with bodily fluids, reporting requirements for sick people (vomiting, jaundice, diarrhea, etc.), restricting ill persons' contact with products, and a return-to-work policy. Skin cuts shall be covered and gloves used, as appropriate. Visual evidence shall show that no violations of the hygiene procedures occur.

Skin cuts shall be covered and gloves used, as appropriate
Visual evidence shall show that no violations of the hygiene procedures occur

campos.label: Todas las personas que trabajan en la finca han recibido capacitación en higiene.
campos.criterio: Basic training on hygiene shall: - Be provided annually to all workers, including owners and managers that are working on the farm - Be provided to all new workers - Cover all necessary instructions - Be given in a format, either written or verbal, that ensures understanding (may be in verbal and pictorial form without written explanatory content, where appropriate) - Specifically include training on hygiene procedures for harvesting and product handling activities, where applicable
verifica: Basic training on hygiene shall: - Be provided annually to all workers, including owners and managers that are working on the farm - Be provided to all new workers - Cover all necessary instructions - Be given in a format, either written or verbal, that ensures understanding (may be in verbal and pictorial form without written explanatory content, where appropriate) - Specifically include training on hygiene procedures for harvesting and product handling activities, where applicable

campos.label: Fumar, comer, masticar y beber se limita a áreas designadas.
campos.criterio: In order to prevent contamination of products, smoking, eating, chewing, and drinking shall be confined to designated areas and not be permitted in product handling or storage areas, unless indicated otherwise by the hygiene risk assessment. Drinking water is the exception.
verifica: In order to prevent contamination of products, smoking, eating, chewing, and drinking shall be confined to designated areas and not be permitted in product handling or storage areas, unless indicated otherwise by the hygiene risk assessment
Drinking water is the exception

campos.label: Se proporcionan baños limpios para los trabajadores, visitantes y subcontratistas cerca de su lugar de trabajo.
campos.criterio: Toilets provided for production and handling activities (including stationary or mobile toilets) shall be: - Designed and located so as to minimize the potential risk for product contamination - Constructed of material that is easy to clean and maintain (also applies to pit latrines) - Allow for direct accessibility for servicing - Located in reasonable proximity to the place of work, i.e., accessible on foot or by a readily available mode of transportation If production and/or handling takes place in a facility, the doors of toilets shall not open directly onto the production and/or product handling area, unless the door is self-closing. Toilets shall be appropriately cleaned, maintained, and stocked. Facilities shall also be available to visitors, where applicable.
verifica: Toilets provided for production and handling activities (including stationary or mobile toilets) shall be: - Designed and located so as to minimize the potential risk for product contamination - Constructed of material that is easy to clean and maintain (also applies to pit latrines) - Allow for direct accessibility for servicing - Located in reasonable proximity to the place of work, i.e., accessible on foot or by a readily available mode of transportation If production and/or handling takes place in a facility, the doors of toilets shall not open directly onto the production and/or product handling area, unless the door is self-closing
Toilets shall be appropriately cleaned, maintained, and stocked
Facilities shall also be available to visitors, where applicable

campos.label: Hay instalaciones para el lavado de manos disponibles para todos los trabajadores, visitantes y subcontratistas que entran en contacto directo con los productos.
campos.criterio: Handwashing facilities shall be accessible and maintained in a clean and sanitary condition to allow workers to clean their hands any time their hands may be a source of contamination. The facilities shall be situated as near as possible to the toilets without posing a risk of cross contamination. All handwashing facilities shall be equipped with nonperfumed hand soap and means of drying hands. Single use towels shall be used where possible. Towels shall not pose a cross contamination risk. Air towels and forced-air hand dryers are permitted. The water used for handwashing shall be analyzed, and risks associated with water quality assessed. The water used shall meet the microbial standard for drinking water at all times. If handwashing water does not meet the microbial drinking water standard, a sanitizer (e.g., alcohol-based gel) shall be used after washing hands. The use of only hand sanitizer to clean hands before coming into contact with products is not permitted.
verifica: Handwashing facilities shall be accessible and maintained in a clean and sanitary condition to allow workers to clean their hands any time their hands may be a source of contamination
The facilities shall be situated as near as possible to the toilets without posing a risk of cross contamination

Single use towels shall be used where possible
Towels shall not pose a cross contamination risk
Air towels and forced-air hand dryers are permitted

The water used shall meet the microbial standard for drinking water at all times

campos.label: Se gestiona la actividad animal que pueda ocasionar la contaminación del producto.
campos.criterio: Appropriate measures shall be taken to reduce possible product contamination by animals within the production area. Where there is evidence of animal activity that may result in product contamination, appropriate measures shall be taken. Eliminating wildlife or using destructive techniques to rid the production area of all animals are not considered appropriate measures.
verifica: Appropriate measures shall be taken to reduce possible product contamination by animals within the production area
Where there is evidence of animal activity that may result in product contamination, appropriate measures shall be taken
Eliminating wildlife or using destructive techniques to rid the production area of all animals are not considered appropriate measures

campos.label: Los recipientes utilizados para la producción y la cosecha se limpian, se mantienen y son apropiados para su uso.
campos.criterio: Production and harvesting containers shall be made of nontoxic materials that do not pose a risk to food safety and be constructed to facilitate cleaning and maintenance. Reusable containers shall be clean before use. A documented cleaning schedule that includes frequency and is in accordance with the hygiene risk assessment shall be in place. Disinfection shall be incorporated into the cleaning procedure when required in the hygiene risk assessment. Harvest containers shall be used exclusively for product (not used to store chemicals, lubricants, oil, trash, tools, etc.).
verifica: Production and harvesting containers shall be made of nontoxic materials that do not pose a risk to food safety and be constructed to facilitate cleaning and maintenance
Reusable containers shall be clean before use

Disinfection shall be incorporated into the cleaning procedure when required in the hygiene risk assessment
Harvest containers shall be used exclusively for product (not used to store chemicals, lubricants, oil, trash, tools, etc.)

secciones.titulo: FV-GFS 20 - Workers’ Health, Safety, And Welfare

campos.label: Existe una evaluación de riesgos documentada para la salud y seguridad de los trabajadores.
campos.criterio: The documented risk assessment shall reflect conditions on the farm, including worker facilities and any on-farm worker housing. The risk assessment shall be reviewed and updated annually and when changes occur that impact workers' health and safety (new machinery, new plant protection products (PPPs), modified cultivation practices, new health risks, etc.). Incidents and accidents shall be recorded. Examples of hazards may include moving machine parts, electricity, vehicle traffic, flammable substances, fertilizer, chemical exposure, excessive noise, dust, vibrations, extreme temperatures, ladders, fuel storage, etc.
verifica: The documented risk assessment shall reflect conditions on the farm, including worker facilities and any on-farm worker housing

The risk assessment shall be reviewed and updated annually and when changes occur that impact workers' health and safety (new machinery, new plant protection products (PPPs), modified cultivation practices, new health risks, etc.)
Incidents and accidents shall be recorded

campos.label: La finca cuenta con procedimientos de salud y seguridad.
campos.criterio: The health and safety procedures shall address the points identified in the risk assessment and be appropriate to the farming operations. The procedures shall be reviewed annually and updated when the risk assessment changes. The farm infrastructure, facilities, on-farm worker housing, and equipment shall be constructed and maintained to minimize health and safety hazards for workers. Accident and emergency procedures shall address work areas, worker facilities, and on-farm worker housing and include contingency plans, i.e., the ability of workers to remove themselves from unsafe situations. Where required by the risk assessment, emergency equipment shall be accessible and maintained. Consideration shall be given to workers at greater risk. Whenever accidents occur, the cause shall be reviewed and appropriate preventive actions included in revised health and safety procedures.
verifica: The health and safety procedures shall address the points identified in the risk assessment and be appropriate to the farming operations
