campos.criterio: The applicant shall undertake an internal QMS audit and internal farm audits of all members/sites and PHUs, covering all products and processes under the certification scope, to verify and ensure compliance with the certification requirements.
verifica: The applicant shall undertake an internal QMS audit and internal farm audits of all members/sites and PHUs, covering all products and processes under the certification scope, to verify and ensure compliance with the certification requirements

campos.label: Las auditorías internas deben hacerse antes de la primera auditoría del OC y luego cada año.
campos.criterio: The internal audits (QMS, PHUs, and members/sites) shall be carried out by the internal auditor(s) before the first CB audit and thereafter once per annum.
verifica: The internal audits (QMS, PHUs, and members/sites) shall be carried out by the internal auditor(s) before the first CB audit and thereafter once per annum

campos.label: Los requisitos del SGC GLOBALG.A.P. deben auditarse al menos una vez al año.
campos.criterio: The GLOBALG.A.P. QMS requirements shall be audited at least annually.
verifica: The GLOBALG.A.P
QMS requirements shall be audited at least annually

campos.label: Los auditores internos del SGC deben cumplir los requisitos mínimos de calificación.
campos.criterio: Internal QMS auditors shall comply with the requirements set in section 8 (GR-Rules for QMS), Minimum qualification requirements for key staff
verifica: Internal QMS auditors shall comply with the requirements set in section 8 (GR-Rules for QMS), Minimum qualification requirements for key staff

campos.label: Sin formación en inocuidad/BPA, otro calificado debe integrar el equipo de auditoría interna.
campos.criterio: Where the internal QMS auditor does not have the necessary training in food safety and/or good agricultural practices (G.A.P.) but only QMS training/experience, another person with these qualifications (and identified in the QMS) shall form part of the internal audit team to perform the internal PHU audits and the approval of the internal farm audits. Persons without food safety and G.A.P. qualifications cannot perform internal farm audits.
verifica: Where the internal QMS auditor does not have the necessary training in food safety and/or good agricultural practices (G.A.P.) but only QMS training/experience, another person with these qualifications (and identified in the QMS) shall form part of the internal audit team to perform the internal PHU audits and the approval of the internal farm audits
Persons without food safety and G.A.P. qualifications cannot perform internal farm audits

campos.label: Los auditores internos del SGC deben ser independientes del área auditada.
campos.criterio: Internal QMS auditors shall be independent of the area being audited.
verifica: Internal QMS auditors shall be independent of the area being audited

campos.label: Quien desarrolla el SGC puede auditarlo, pero su gestor diario no puede hacer la auditoría interna.
campos.criterio: The same person who initially develops the QMS may undertake the required internal QMS audits. However, the person responsible for the day-to-day ongoing management of the QMS is not allowed to conduct the internal QMS audits.
verifica: The same person who initially develops the QMS may undertake the required internal QMS audits
However, the person responsible for the day-to-day ongoing management of the QMS is not allowed to conduct the internal QMS audits

campos.label: Debes mantener registros de la auditoría interna, hallazgos y seguimiento de acciones correctivas.
campos.criterio: Records of the internal QMS audit, internal audit findings, and follow-up of corrective actions resulting from the internal QMS audit(s) shall be maintained and available.
verifica: Records of the internal QMS audit, internal audit findings, and follow-up of corrective actions resulting from the internal QMS audit(s) shall be maintained and available

campos.label: La lista de verificación del SGC debe tener comentarios por requisito y estar disponible para el OC.
campos.criterio: The completed QMS checklist (including central PHU requirements, where applicable) shall include comments for every QMS requirement and shall be available on-site for review by the CB auditor during the CB audit.
verifica: The completed QMS checklist (including central PHU requirements, where applicable) shall include comments for every QMS requirement and shall be available on-site for review by the CB auditor during the CB audit

campos.label: La lista del SGC debe incluir nombre y firma del representante auditado y del auditor interno.
campos.criterio: The QMS checklist shall include the name and signature of the audited QMS representative, as well as the name and signature of the internal QMS auditor.
verifica: The QMS checklist shall include the name and signature of the audited QMS representative, as well as the name and signature of the internal QMS auditor

campos.label: Si la auditoría del SGC se hace de forma continua en 12 meses, debe haber cronograma predefinido.
campos.criterio: Where the internal QMS audit is not performed in 1 day but continuously over a 12-month period, a predefined schedule shall be in place.
verifica: Where the internal QMS audit is not performed in 1 day but continuously over a 12-month period, a predefined schedule shall be in place

campos.label: La auditoría interna del SGC debe basarse en los requisitos del SGC de GLOBALG.A.P.
campos.criterio: The internal QMS audit shall be based on the GLOBALG.A.P. QMS requirements.
verifica: The internal QMS audit shall be based on the GLOBALG.A.P
QMS requirements

campos.label: Debes auditar internamente cada miembro/sitio al menos una vez al año contra los P&C aplicables.
campos.criterio: Internal farm audits against all relevant GLOBALG.A.P. P&Cs shall be carried out at each registered member/site (including corresponding production sites and PHUs) at least once per year. Farm/Site production-related records (e.g., medicine/plant protection product (PPP) application records) shall be present and audited on-farm to cross-check them with the farm situation (e.g., products, interviews, stores).
verifica: Internal farm audits against all relevant GLOBALG.A.P
P&Cs shall be carried out at each registered member/site (including corresponding production sites and PHUs) at least once per year

Farm/Site production-related records (e.g., medicine/plant protection product (PPP) application records) shall be present and audited on-farm to cross-check them with the farm situation (e.g., products, interviews, stores)

campos.label: El calendario de la auditoría interna de finca debe seguir las reglas del RG y del alcance.
campos.criterio: Internal farm audit timing shall follow the rules defined in the GLOBALG.A.P. GR and scope-specific rules.
verifica: Internal farm audit timing shall follow the rules defined in the GLOBALG.A.P
GR and scope-specific rules

campos.label: Los auditores internos de finca deben cumplir los requisitos mínimos de calificación.
campos.criterio: Internal farm auditors shall comply with the requirements set in section 8 (GR-Rules for QMS), Minimum qualification requirements for key staff.
verifica: Internal farm auditors shall comply with the requirements set in section 8 (GR-Rules for QMS), Minimum qualification requirements for key staff

campos.label: Los auditores internos de finca deben ser independientes y no auditar su propio trabajo.
campos.criterio: Internal farm auditors shall be independent of the area being audited and therefore be assigned via the QMS. Internal farm auditors cannot audit their own daily work.
verifica: Internal farm auditors shall be independent of the area being audited and therefore be assigned via the QMS
Internal farm auditors cannot audit their own daily work

campos.label: Todo nuevo miembro/sitio debe auditarse y aprobarse antes de ingresar al registro interno.
campos.criterio: New members/sites shall always be internally audited and approved prior to being entered in the QMS internal register (see section QMS 01.02.01 Internal register - Multisite producers with QMS).
verifica: New members/sites shall always be internally audited and approved prior to being entered in the QMS internal register (see section QMS 01.02.01 Internal register - Multisite producers with QMS)

campos.label: Debes conservar los informes y notas originales de auditoría interna para la auditoría del OC.
campos.criterio: The original internal farm audit reports and notes shall be maintained and available for the CB audit.
verifica: The original internal farm audit reports and notes shall be maintained and available for the CB audit

campos.label: El informe de auditoría interna de finca debe contener toda la información requerida.
campos.criterio: The internal farm audit report shall contain the following information: (i) Identification of registered member(s)/site(s) (ii) Signature of the registered member and/or person responsible for the production site (iii) Date (iv) Internal farm auditor name and signature (v) Registered products (vi) Internal farm audit result against each of the GLOBALG.A.P. P&Cs. (vii) Comments on P&Cs. Unless the GLOBALG.A.P. Secretariat issues a separate document predetermining which P&Cs shall be commented on, the checklist shall include details in the comments section for the Major Must P&Cs that are found to be compliant, Major Must and Minor Must P&Cs that are found to be non-compliant, and/or not applicable. This is necessary so that the audit trail can be reviewed after the event. Recommendations do not require comments. (viii) Details of any non-compliances identified and period for implementation of corrective actions (ix) Internal farm audit results with calculation of compliance (x) Duration of the internal farm audit (record of start and end time) (xi) Name of internal QMS auditor who approved the audit report. Any other evidence of review and approval is also possible.
verifica: The internal farm audit report shall contain the following information:

(i) Identification of registered member(s)/site(s) (ii) Signature of the registered member and/or person responsible for the production site (iii) Date (iv) Internal farm auditor name and signature (v) Registered products (vi) Internal farm audit result against each of the GLOBALG.A.P
(vii) Comments on P&Cs
Unless the GLOBALG.A.P

Secretariat issues a separate document predetermining which P&Cs shall be commented on, the checklist shall include details in the comments section for the Major Must P&Cs that are found to be compliant, Major Must and Minor Must P&Cs that are found to be non-compliant, and/or not applicable
This is necessary so that the audit trail can be reviewed after the event
Recommendations do not require comments

(viii) Details of any non-compliances identified and period for implementation of corrective actions (ix) Internal farm audit results with calculation of compliance (x) Duration of the internal farm audit (record of start and end time) (xi) Name of internal QMS auditor who approved the audit report

campos.label: El auditor interno del SGC decide la conformidad del miembro según los informes de auditoría.
campos.criterio: The internal QMS auditor (or internal audit team; see section QMS 05.01 c)) shall review and make the decision on whether the member/site is compliant with the GLOBALG.A.P. requirements based on the internal farm audit reports presented.
verifica: The internal QMS auditor (or internal audit team; see section QMS 05.01 c)) shall review and make the decision on whether the member/site is compliant with the GLOBALG.A.P. requirements based on the internal farm audit reports presented

campos.label: Si hay un único auditor interno que también audita fincas, el gestor del SGC aprueba esas auditorías.
campos.criterio: If there is only one internal QMS auditor who also performs the internal farm audits, the QMS manager shall approve the internal farm audits.
verifica: If there is only one internal QMS auditor who also performs the internal farm audits, the QMS manager shall approve the internal farm audits

campos.label: Si las auditorías internas se hacen de forma continua en 12 meses, debe haber cronograma predefinido.
campos.criterio: Where the internal audits take place continuously over a 12-month period, a predefined schedule shall be in place. This is not applicable for initial certification audits.
verifica: Where the internal audits take place continuously over a 12-month period, a predefined schedule shall be in place
This is not applicable for initial certification audits

campos.label: Debe haber procedimiento documentado para gestionar no conformidades y acciones correctivas.
campos.criterio: There shall be a documented procedure for handling the non-compliances and corrective actions which may result from internal or CB audits, customer complaints, or failure of the QMS. This procedure shall describe how to identify and evaluate non-conformances and non-compliances detected at the QMS, PHU, and member/site levels.
verifica: There shall be a documented procedure for handling the non-compliances and corrective actions which may result from internal or CB audits, customer complaints, or failure of the QMS
This procedure shall describe how to identify and evaluate non-conformances and non-compliances detected at the QMS, PHU, and member/site levels

campos.label: Las acciones correctivas deben evaluarse y fijarse un plazo para su implementación.
campos.criterio: Corrective actions following non-compliances shall be evaluated and a timescale defined for action.
verifica: Corrective actions following non-compliances shall be evaluated and a timescale defined for action

campos.label: La responsabilidad de implementar y resolver acciones correctivas debe estar definida.
campos.criterio: Responsibility for implementing and resolving corrective actions shall be clearly defined.
verifica: Responsibility for implementing and resolving corrective actions shall be clearly defined

campos.label: Debe aplicarse a todos los miembros un sistema de sanciones decidido por el SGC.
campos.criterio: A system of sanctions that meets the requirements defined in section 7.4.3 of GR QMS shall apply to all members/sites. All internal sanctions shall be decided by the QMS.
verifica: A system of sanctions that meets the requirements defined in section 7.4.3 of GR QMS shall apply to all members/sites
All internal sanctions shall be decided by the QMS

campos.label: No se puede suspender parcialmente un producto de un miembro; debe suspenderse completo.
campos.criterio: A product cannot be partially suspended for a member/site (i.e., the entire product shall be suspended).
verifica: A product cannot be partially suspended for a member/site (i.e., the entire product shall be suspended)

campos.label: Debe haber mecanismos para notificar de inmediato al OC suspensiones o cancelaciones.
campos.criterio: Mechanisms shall be in place to immediately notify the GLOBALG.A.P. approved CB about suspensions or cancellations of registered members/sites.
verifica: Mechanisms shall be in place to immediately notify the GLOBALG.A.P. approved CB about suspensions or cancellations of registered members/sites

campos.label: Debes mantener registro de todas las sanciones, acciones correctivas y decisiones tomadas.
campos.criterio: Records shall be maintained of all sanctions, including evidence of subsequent corrective actions and decision-making processes.
verifica: Records shall be maintained of all sanctions, including evidence of subsequent corrective actions and decision-making processes

campos.label: Un miembro no puede cambiar de grupo hasta cerrar la no conformidad que motivó la sanción.
campos.criterio: Producer group members cannot change producer groups until the non-conformance that led to the respective sanction is satisfactorily closed.
verifica: Producer group members cannot change producer groups until the non-conformance that led to the respective sanction is satisfactorily closed

campos.label: El grupo puede levantar las suspensiones que él mismo impuso a sus miembros aceptados.
campos.criterio: Producer groups can lift product suspensions and self-suspensions issued by themselves on their accepted producer group members.
verifica: Producer groups can lift product suspensions and self-suspensions issued by themselves on their accepted producer group members

campos.label: Debe existir un procedimiento documentado de identificación y trazabilidad de productos al miembro.
campos.criterio: There shall be a documented procedure for identifying registered products and ensuring traceability of all products (conforming and non-conforming) to their members/sites.
verifica: There shall be a documented procedure for identifying registered products and ensuring traceability of all products (conforming and non-conforming) to their members/sites

campos.label: Debe realizarse un balance de masas anual por producto registrado dentro de la entidad titular.
campos.criterio: A mass balance exercise shall be carried out at least annually for each registered product to demonstrate compliance within the certificate holder's legal entity.
verifica: A mass balance exercise shall be carried out at least annually for each registered product to demonstrate compliance within the certificate holder's legal entity

campos.label: Debes segregar eficazmente los productos certificados de los no certificados para evitar mezclas.
campos.criterio: Products meeting the requirements of the relevant GLOBALG.A.P. standard and marketed as such shall be handled in a manner that prevents their being mixed with products not meeting the requirements of the GLOBALG.A.P. standard. An effective system shall be in place to ensure segregation of products originating from certified and noncertified production processes. This can be done via physical identification or product handling procedures, including the relevant records.
verifica: Products meeting the requirements of the relevant GLOBALG.A.P. standard and marketed as such shall be handled in a manner that prevents their being mixed with products not meeting the requirements of the GLOBALG.A.P. standard
An effective system shall be in place to ensure segregation of products originating from certified and noncertified production processes
This can be done via physical identification or product handling procedures, including the relevant records

campos.label: Debes prevenir el mal etiquetado identificando el producto conforme con su número GLOBALG.A.P.
campos.criterio: Effective systems and procedures shall be in place to prevent any mislabeling of products originating from GLOBALG.A.P. certified and noncertified production processes. Conforming products entering the PHU(s) (either from members/sites or from external sources) shall be immediately identified with a GLOBALG.A.P. identification number (e.g., GGN) or any other reference that is clearly explained in the QMS procedures and provides a unique reference to their certification status in order to ensure proper segregation during handling processes. This reference shall be used on the smallest individually identified unit.
verifica: Effective systems and procedures shall be in place to prevent any mislabeling of products originating from GLOBALG.A.P. certified and noncertified production processes

Conforming products entering the PHU(s) (either from members/sites or from external sources) shall be immediately identified with a GLOBALG.A.P. identification number (e.g., GGN) or any other reference that is clearly explained in the QMS procedures and provides a unique reference to their certification status in order to ensure proper segregation during handling processes
This reference shall be used on the smallest individually identified unit

campos.label: Si etiquetas con número GLOBALG.A.P. (GGN), úsalo según las reglas en la unidad más pequeña.
campos.criterio: If the certificate holder wants to label their products with a GLOBALG.A.P. identification number (e.g., GGN), it can be the identification number of the certificate holder (producer group/multisite producer), the identification number of the producer group member who produced the product, or both numbers. If producer group members pack and label the product, the producer group may require those members to include the identification number of the producer group (e.g., the GGN of the producer group) with or without the identification number of the producer group member. In the case of multisite producers with QMS, it shall be the identification number of the certificate holder. The identification number shall be used on the smallest individually packed unit, regardless of whether this unit is final consumer packaging or not. The GLOBALG.A.P. identification number shall not be used to label products originating from noncertified production processes.
verifica: If the certificate holder wants to label their products with a GLOBALG.A.P. identification number (e.g., GGN), it can be the identification number of the certificate holder (producer group/multisite producer), the identification number of the producer group member who produced the product, or both numbers

If producer group members pack and label the product, the producer group may require those members to include the identification number of the producer group (e.g., the GGN of the producer group) with or without the identification number of the producer group member
In the case of multisite producers with QMS, it shall be the identification number of the certificate holder
The identification number shall be used on the smallest individually packed unit, regardless of whether this unit is final consumer packaging or not
The GLOBALG.A.P. identification number shall not be used to label products originating from noncertified production processes

campos.label: En PO, identifica el producto certificado con su GGN, garantizando trazabilidad y segregación total.
campos.criterio: The individual producer/producer group registered for PO shall identify all final ready-to-be-sold products (either from farm level or after product handling) with the individual producer's/producer group's GLOBALG.A.P. identification number if the product is certified. The GLOBALG.A.P. identification number shall not be used to label noncertified products. In the cases of multisite producers with a QMS and producer groups, the QMS shall ensure correct use of the GLOBALG.A.P. identification number. All products shall be traceable to the respective production site/product handling unit (PHU), and certified and noncertified products shall be fully segregated at all times. The individual producer/producer group shall be able to demonstrate that their traceability and recording system guarantees full traceability and segregation. Having IFA v6 Smart and IFA v6 GFS certification at the same time is not considered PO. However, whenever a need arises to identify and segregate the certified product according to the IFA v6 Smart and IFA v6 GFS editions, the individual producer/producer group shall use the GLOBALG.A.P. identification number for IFA v6 Smart (e.g., GGN_1234567890123) and the GLOBALG.A.P. identification number with GFS extension for IFA v6 GFS (e.g., GGN_1234567890123_GFS). Note: For requirements on parallel ownership, including product labeling, please see “GLOBALG.A.P. general regulations – Rules for parallel ownership.”
verifica: The individual producer/producer group registered for PO shall identify all final ready-to-be-sold products (either from farm level or after product handling) with the individual producer's/producer group's GLOBALG.A.P. identification number if the product is certified
The GLOBALG.A.P. identification number shall not be used to label noncertified products
In the cases of multisite producers with a QMS and producer groups, the QMS shall ensure correct use of the GLOBALG.A.P. identification number
All products shall be traceable to the respective production site/product handling unit (PHU), and certified and noncertified products shall be fully segregated at all times
The individual producer/producer group shall be able to demonstrate that their traceability and recording system guarantees full traceability and segregation
Having IFA v6 Smart and IFA v6 GFS certification at the same time is not considered PO

However, whenever a need arises to identify and segregate the certified product according to the IFA v6 Smart and IFA v6 GFS editions, the individual producer/producer group shall use the GLOBALG.A.P. identification number for IFA v6 Smart (e.g., GGN_1234567890123) and the GLOBALG.A.P. identification number with GFS extension for IFA v6 GFS (e.g., GGN_1234567890123_GFS)
For requirements on parallel ownership, including product labeling, please see “GLOBALG.A.P. general regulations – Rules for parallel ownership.”

campos.label: Debe haber una verificación documental final del despacho correcto de producto certificado/no.
campos.criterio: There shall be a final document check to ensure correct product dispatch of products originating from certified and noncertified production processes.
verifica: There shall be a final document check to ensure correct product dispatch of products originating from certified and noncertified production processes

campos.label: La documentación de venta de producto certificado debe incluir el GGN y el estado de certificación.
campos.criterio: All transaction documentation (sales invoices, other sales-related documents, dispatch documentation, etc.) related to sales of products coming from a certified production process shall include the GLOBALG.A.P. identification number of the certificate holder and shall contain a reference to the GLOBALG.A.P. certification status. This is not obligatory in internal documentation. Positive identification is enough (e.g., “GGN_GLOBALG.A.P. certified <product name>”). Indication of the certification status is obligatory regardless of whether the certified product (i.e., product coming from a certified production process) is sold as certified or not. This, however, cannot be checked during the initial CB audit because the producer group/multisite producer is not yet certified and cannot refer to the GLOBALG.A.P. certification status before the first positive certification decision.
verifica: All transaction documentation (sales invoices, other sales-related documents, dispatch documentation, etc.) related to sales of products coming from a certified production process shall include the GLOBALG.A.P. identification number of the certificate holder and shall contain a reference to the GLOBALG.A.P. certification status
This is not obligatory in internal documentation
Positive identification is enough (e.g., “GGN_GLOBALG.A.P. certified <product name>”)
Indication of the certification status is obligatory regardless of whether the certified product (i.e., product coming from a certified production process) is sold as certified or not

This, however, cannot be checked during the initial CB audit because the producer group/multisite producer is not yet certified and cannot refer to the GLOBALG.A.P. certification status before the first positive certification decision

campos.label: Debes documentar procedimientos y registros para identificar el producto entrante certificado/no.
campos.criterio: Appropriately to the scale of the operation, procedures shall be established, documented, and maintained for identifying incoming products originating from certified and noncertified production processes from members/sites or purchased from different sources (i.e., other producers or traders). Records shall include: (i) Product description (ii) GLOBALG.A.P. certification status (iii) Quantities of incoming/purchased product(s) (iv) List of approved suppliers and supplier details (v) Copy of the GLOBALG.A.P. certificates, in case of products originating from certified production processes (vi) Traceability data/codes related to the incoming/purchased products (vii) Purchase orders/invoices received by the certificate holder
verifica: Appropriately to the scale of the operation, procedures shall be established, documented, and maintained for identifying incoming products originating from certified and noncertified production processes from members/sites or purchased from different sources (i.e., other producers or traders)
Records shall include:

(i) Product description (ii) GLOBALG.A.P. certification status (iii) Quantities of incoming/purchased product(s) (iv) List of approved suppliers and supplier details (v) Copy of the GLOBALG.A.P. certificates, in case of products originating from certified production processes (vi) Traceability data/codes related to the incoming/purchased products (vii) Purchase orders/invoices received by the certificate holder

campos.label: Debes registrar las ventas de producto certificado y no certificado, con foco en lo certificado.
campos.criterio: Sales details of products originating from certified and noncertified production processes shall be recorded, with particular attention to quantities delivered/sold as originating from certified production processes.
verifica: Sales details of products originating from certified and noncertified production processes shall be recorded, with particular attention to quantities delivered/sold as originating from certified production processes

campos.label: Debes registrar cantidades de entrada, salida y stock para verificar el balance de masas anual.
campos.criterio: Quantities (including information on volumes or weight) of incoming, outgoing, and stored products (including the certification status, whether originating from certified or noncertified production processes) shall be recorded and a summary maintained so as to facilitate the mass balance verification process. The documents shall demonstrate the consistent balance between certified and noncertified input and the output. The frequency of the mass balance verification shall be defined and appropriate to the scale of the operation, but the verification shall be done at least annually for each product. Documents for demonstrating mass balance shall be clearly identified. During initial CB audits, the system shall be ready, but there are still no records available, as the processes have not yet been certified.
verifica: Quantities (including information on volumes or weight) of incoming, outgoing, and stored products (including the certification status, whether originating from certified or noncertified production processes) shall be recorded and a summary maintained so as to facilitate the mass balance verification process
The documents shall demonstrate the consistent balance between certified and noncertified input and the output
The frequency of the mass balance verification shall be defined and appropriate to the scale of the operation, but the verification shall be done at least annually for each product
Documents for demonstrating mass balance shall be clearly identified
During initial CB audits, the system shall be ready, but there are still no records available, as the processes have not yet been certified

campos.label: Las PHU deben operar procedimientos de identificación y trazabilidad desde recepción a despacho.
campos.criterio: The PHUs included in the certification scope shall operate procedures that enable registered products to be identifiable and traceable from receipt through handling, storage, and dispatch.
verifica: The PHUs included in the certification scope shall operate procedures that enable registered products to be identifiable and traceable from receipt through handling, storage, and dispatch

campos.label: Debes calcular y documentar ratios de conversión, mermas y desperdicios de cada proceso.
campos.criterio: Conversion ratios shall be calculated and available for each relevant handling process. All generated product waste quantities shall be recorded. Losses due to handling, sorting, grading, and other shall be calculated and records of the losses shall be available for each handling process where loss occurs. The losses can be estimated but shall be justifiable and supported by records. A valid estimated record of the quantity or volume of harvested/slaughtered/processed product shall be compared with the records of the amount of product sold.
verifica: Conversion ratios shall be calculated and available for each relevant handling process
All generated product waste quantities shall be recorded
Losses due to handling, sorting, grading, and other shall be calculated and records of the losses shall be available for each handling process where loss occurs
The losses can be estimated but shall be justifiable and supported by records
A valid estimated record of the quantity or volume of harvested/slaughtered/processed product shall be compared with the records of the amount of product sold

campos.label: Esta sección debe auditarse interna y por el OC también a nivel de PHU mientras operan.
campos.criterio: This section shall be audited both internally and by the CB also at PHU level while PHUs are in operation.
verifica: This section shall be audited both internally and by the CB also at PHU level while PHUs are in operation

campos.label: Debe haber procedimientos documentados para gestionar el retiro de productos registrados.
campos.criterio: Documented procedures shall be in place to effectively manage the withdrawal of registered products.
verifica: Documented procedures shall be in place to effectively manage the withdrawal of registered products

campos.label: El procedimiento debe definir eventos, responsables, notificación al OC y reconciliación de stock.
campos.criterio: Procedures shall identify the types of events that may result in a withdrawal, persons responsible for taking decisions on the possible product withdrawal, the mechanism for notifying customers and the GLOBALG.A.P. approved CB, and methods of reconciling stock.
verifica: Procedures shall identify the types of events that may result in a withdrawal, persons responsible for taking decisions on the possible product withdrawal, the mechanism for notifying customers and the GLOBALG.A.P. approved CB, and methods of reconciling stock

campos.label: El procedimiento de retiro debe poder ejecutarse en cualquier momento.
campos.criterio: The procedure shall be capable of being operated at any time.
verifica: The procedure shall be capable of being operated at any time

campos.label: El procedimiento de retiro debe probarse al menos una vez al año y conservar el registro.
campos.criterio: The procedure shall be tested in an appropriate manner at least annually to ensure that it is effective and records of the test retained. If a real withdrawal occurred during the last 12 months, it can be counted as the annual test.
verifica: The procedure shall be tested in an appropriate manner at least annually to ensure that it is effective and records of the test retained
If a real withdrawal occurred during the last 12 months, it can be counted as the annual test

campos.label: Las actividades subcontratadas deben realizarse conforme a los requisitos de la norma.
campos.criterio: Where any activities are outsourced to third parties, procedures shall exist to ensure that these activities are carried out in accordance with the requirements of the relevant GLOBALG.A.P. standard.
verifica: Where any activities are outsourced to third parties, procedures shall exist to ensure that these activities are carried out in accordance with the requirements of the relevant GLOBALG.A.P. standard

campos.label: Debes mantener registros que demuestren la evaluación de competencia de cada subcontratista.
campos.criterio: Records shall be maintained to demonstrate that the competency of any subcontractor is assessed and meets the requirements of the relevant GLOBALG.A.P. standard.
verifica: Records shall be maintained to demonstrate that the competency of any subcontractor is assessed and meets the requirements of the relevant GLOBALG.A.P. standard

campos.label: Los subcontratistas deben trabajar según los procedimientos del SGC, especificados en contratos.
campos.criterio: Subcontractors shall work in accordance with the QMS-relevant procedures and this shall be specified in service level agreements or contracts.
verifica: Subcontractors shall work in accordance with the QMS-relevant procedures and this shall be specified in service level agreements or contracts

campos.label: Si la PHU subcontratada tiene certificación GFSI, audita al menos segregación y trazabilidad.
campos.criterio: If the PHU is subcontracted and it already has a post-farm gate food safety certification recognized by the Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) for scope BIII (www.mygfsi.com), the internal QMS auditor shall audit as a minimum segregation and traceability, as well as postharvest treatments, if applicable. The internal QMS auditor may reaudit all other applicable P&Cs in the case of doubt. If the subcontracted PHU is included in another GLOBALG.A.P. certification (e.g., IFA, CoC, PHA), the QMS may accept this certificate or may decide to perform its own internal audit of the PHU.
verifica: If the PHU is subcontracted and it already has a post-farm gate food safety certification recognized by the Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) for scope BIII (www.mygfsi.com), the internal QMS auditor shall audit as a minimum segregation and traceability, as well as postharvest treatments, if applicable
The internal QMS auditor may reaudit all other applicable P&Cs in the case of doubt
If the subcontracted PHU is included in another GLOBALG.A.P. certification (e.g., IFA, CoC, PHA), the QMS may accept this certificate or may decide to perform its own internal audit of the PHU

secciones.titulo: QMS 9 - Registration Of Additional Members/Sites To The Certificate

campos.label: Pueden agregarse nuevos miembros/sitios al certificado, notificando de inmediato al OC.
campos.criterio: New sites and members may be added to a valid certificate (provided internal approval procedures are met). It is the responsibility of the certificate holder to immediately update the CB on any addition or withdrawal of members/sites to/from the list of approved members/sites.
verifica: New sites and members may be added to a valid certificate (provided internal approval procedures are met)
It is the responsibility of the certificate holder to immediately update the CB on any addition or withdrawal of members/sites to/from the list of approved members/sites

campos.label: Hasta el 10% de nuevos miembros al año puede agregarse sin verificación adicional del OC.
campos.criterio: Up to 10% of new members/sites in one year can be added to the approved list by registering the members or sites without necessarily resorting to further verification by the CB.
verifica: Up to 10% of new members/sites in one year can be added to the approved list by registering the members or sites without necessarily resorting to further verification by the CB

campos.label: Si los miembros aprobados crecen más del 10% al año, el OC debe auditar los nuevos y el SGC.
campos.criterio: If the number of approved members/sites increases by more than 10% in one year, further CB farm audits of the newly added members/sites and an audit of at least the relevant part of the QMS will be required before additional members/sites can be added to the certificate. The relevant part of the QMS is the internal approval procedure: internal farm audit, review of the internal farm audit report, inclusion of the new member/site in the QMS internal register with status “approved.”
verifica: If the number of approved members/sites increases by more than 10% in one year, further CB farm audits of the newly added members/sites and an audit of at least the relevant part of the QMS will be required before additional members/sites can be added to the certificate

The relevant part of the QMS is the internal approval procedure: internal farm audit, review of the internal farm audit report, inclusion of the new member/site in the QMS internal register with status “approved.”

campos.label: Si el área o cambio de miembros supera el 10% anual, se requieren auditorías adicionales del OC.
campos.criterio: Regardless of the percentage by which the number of approved members/sites increases in one year, should the newly registered farms increase the production area or quantity produced (in the case of aquaculture) of previously registered products by more than 10% in one year, or a change in members/sites exceeds 10%, further CB audits of the newly added members/sites and a CB audit of at least the relevant part of the QMS is required before additional members/sites can be added to the certificate.
verifica: Regardless of the percentage by which the number of approved members/sites increases in one year, should the newly registered farms increase the production area or quantity produced (in the case of aquaculture) of previously registered products by more than 10% in one year, or a change in members/sites exceeds 10%, further CB audits of the newly added members/sites and a CB audit of at least the relevant part of the QMS is required before additional members/sites can be added to the certificate

campos.label: En estos casos, la muestra mínima a auditar por el OC es la raíz cuadrada de los nuevos miembros.
campos.criterio: In c) and d) the minimum sample of members/sites to be audited by a CB is the square root of the number of new members/sites.
verifica: In c) and d) the minimum sample of members/sites to be audited by a CB is the square root of the number of new members/sites

campos.label: Para añadir un producto nuevo, el OC audita la raíz cuadrada de los miembros que lo cultivan.
campos.criterio: Regardless of the number of members/sites and the increase in quantity, if a new product is to be added to the certificate between surveillance CB audits and certification audits, a CB audit shall be carried out to the square root of the members/sites growing the new product.
verifica: Regardless of the number of members/sites and the increase in quantity, if a new product is to be added to the certificate between surveillance CB audits and certification audits, a CB audit shall be carried out to the square root of the members/sites growing the new product

campos.label: Debes usar la declaración GLOBALG.A.P. según las reglas de uso de marcas registradas.
campos.criterio: The producer group/multisite producer shall use the GLOBALG.A.P. claim according to the rules in “GLOBALG.A.P. trademarks use: Policy and guidelines.”
verifica: The producer group/multisite producer shall use the GLOBALG.A.P. claim according to the rules in “GLOBALG.A.P. trademarks use:
Policy and guidelines.”

secciones.titulo: QMS 11 - Minimum Qualification Requirements For Key Staff

campos.code: QMS 11 Minimum Qualification requirements for key staff
campos.label: Los OC deben evaluar anualmente la calificación de los auditores internos.
campos.criterio: NOTE: The qualification of internal auditors shall be evaluated annually by the CBs.
verifica: The qualification of internal auditors shall be evaluated annually by the CBs

campos.label: El gestor del SGC administra el sistema para asegurar el cumplimiento de todos los miembros y PHU.
campos.criterio: The QMS manager shall manage the organization's QMS in order to ensure compliance by all registered members/sites and PHUs. This includes, for example, development and control of QMS documentation, management of an internal register, receiving the QMS audits (both internal and by the CB), and implementing the necessary corrective actions.
verifica: The QMS manager shall manage the organization's QMS in order to ensure compliance by all registered members/sites and PHUs

This includes, for example, development and control of QMS documentation, management of an internal register, receiving the QMS audits (both internal and by the CB), and implementing the necessary corrective actions

campos.label: El gestor del SGC puede realizar auditorías internas de finca a los miembros/sitios.
campos.criterio: The QMS manager may conduct internal farm audits (at members/sites) to assess compliance with the certification requirements.
verifica: The QMS manager may conduct internal farm audits (at members/sites) to assess compliance with the certification requirements

campos.label: El gestor del SGC debe producir informes oportunos y precisos de las auditorías internas de finca.
campos.criterio: The QMS manager shall produce timely and accurate reports on such internal farm audits.
verifica: The QMS manager shall produce timely and accurate reports on such internal farm audits

campos.label: El gestor del SGC no puede realizar las auditorías internas del propio SGC.
campos.criterio: However, the QMS manager shall not perform internal QMS audits.
verifica: However, the QMS manager shall not perform internal QMS audits

campos.label: Si no audita fincas, el gestor del SGC puede aprobar miembros según los informes del auditor.
campos.criterio: If the QMS manager does not perform the internal farm audits, they can approve the members/sites based on the audit reports of the internal farm auditor(s).
verifica: If the QMS manager does not perform the internal farm audits, they can approve the members/sites based on the audit reports of the internal farm auditor(s)

campos.label: El auditor interno del SGC audita el SGC y las PHU centrales para verificar el cumplimiento.
campos.criterio: The internal QMS auditor audits the QMS and central PHUs of the producer group/multisite producer with QMS to assess compliance with the certification requirements.
verifica: The internal QMS auditor audits the QMS and central PHUs of the producer group/multisite producer with QMS to assess compliance with the certification requirements

campos.label: El auditor del SGC debe producir informes oportunos y precisos de dichas auditorías.
campos.criterio: The QMS auditor shall produce timely and accurate reports on such audits.
verifica: The QMS auditor shall produce timely and accurate reports on such audits

campos.label: El auditor del SGC puede aprobar miembros, pero no sus propias auditorías de finca.
campos.criterio: The QMS auditor may approve the members/sites based on the audit reports of the internal farm auditor(s). If internal QMS auditors conduct the farm audits, they shall not approve those audit reports.
verifica: The QMS auditor may approve the members/sites based on the audit reports of the internal farm auditor(s)
If internal QMS auditors conduct the farm audits, they shall not approve those audit reports

campos.label: El auditor interno de finca audita los miembros/sitios y sus PHU para verificar el cumplimiento.
campos.criterio: The internal farm auditor conducts farm audits at members/sites and their PHUs (of producer group members) to assess compliance with the certification requirements.
verifica: The internal farm auditor conducts farm audits at members/sites and their PHUs (of producer group members) to assess compliance with the certification requirements

campos.label: El auditor interno de finca debe producir informes oportunos y precisos de dichas auditorías.
campos.criterio: The internal farm auditor shall produce timely and accurate reports on such audits.
verifica: The internal farm auditor shall produce timely and accurate reports on such audits

campos.label: El auditor interno de finca no puede realizar las tareas del auditor interno del SGC.
campos.criterio: The internal farm auditor shall not perform internal QMS auditor tasks.
verifica: The internal farm auditor shall not perform internal QMS auditor tasks

campos.label: El auditor del SGC requiere titulación o calificación con la experiencia mínima definida.
campos.criterio: A post-high school diploma in a discipline related to the scope of certification (plants and/or aquaculture); or an agricultural high school qualification with two years of experience in the relevant scope after qualification; or any other high school qualification with two years of experience in QMS and three years of experience in the relevant scope after qualification.
verifica: A post-high school diploma in a discipline related to the scope of certification (plants and/or aquaculture); or an agricultural high school qualification with two years of experience in the relevant scope after qualification; or any other high school qualification with two years of experience in QMS and three years of experience in the relevant scope after qualification

campos.label: El auditor de finca requiere titulación o calificación con la experiencia sectorial mínima definida.
campos.criterio: A post-high school diploma in a discipline related to the scope of certification (plants and/or aquaculture); or an agricultural high school qualification with two years of experience in the relevant scope after qualification; or any other high school qualification with three years of sector-specific experience (e.g., farm management, including own operations in the relevant product; commercial consultant in the relevant product; field experience relevant to specific products) and participation in educational opportunities relevant to the scope of certification.
verifica: A post-high school diploma in a discipline related to the scope of certification (plants and/or aquaculture); or an agricultural high school qualification with two years of experience in the relevant scope after qualification; or any other high school qualification with three years of sector-specific experience (e.g., farm management, including own operations in the relevant product; commercial consultant in the relevant product; field experience relevant to specific products) and participation in educational opportunities relevant to the scope of certification

campos.label: Debe completar formación de auditor interno del SGC y de la norma (mínimo 16 horas en total).
campos.criterio: Completion of internal QMS auditor training related to QMS and training related to the relevant GLOBALG.A.P. standard (total minimum duration of 16 hours).
verifica: Completion of internal QMS auditor training related to QMS and training related to the relevant GLOBALG.A.P. standard (total minimum duration of 16 hours)

campos.label: El auditor interno del SGC debe tener conocimiento práctico del SGC.
campos.criterio: Practical knowledge of QMS.
verifica: Practical knowledge of QMS

campos.label: Debe completar formación de auditor interno relacionada con el SGC (mínimo 16 horas).
campos.criterio: Completion of internal QMS auditor training related to QMS (minimum duration 16 hours).
verifica: Completion of internal QMS auditor training related to QMS (minimum duration 16 hours)

campos.code: QMS 12.3.3  Technical skills and qualifications - Internal farm auditor
campos.label: La habilitación del auditor interno de finca solo procede tras cumplir lo siguiente:
campos.criterio: Sign-off of internal farm auditors shall only occur as a result of:
verifica: Sign-off of internal farm auditors shall only occur as a result of:

campos.label: Formación práctica de auditoría de un día sobre los principios básicos de auditar.
campos.criterio: One-day practical audit training setting out basic principles of auditing.
verifica: One-day practical audit training setting out basic principles of auditing

campos.label: Observar dos auditorías de finca y realizar una auditoría testigo exitosa supervisada.
campos.criterio: Observing two CB or internal GLOBALG.A.P. farm audits (or other) by an already qualified auditor, and one successful witness audit by the internal QMS auditor, by a qualified internal farm auditor, or by the CB.
verifica: Observing two CB or internal GLOBALG.A.P. farm audits (or other) by an already qualified auditor, and one successful witness audit by the internal QMS auditor, by a qualified internal farm auditor, or by the CB

campos.label: Formación en el sistema HACCP o en normas de gestión de inocuidad alimentaria.
campos.criterio: Training in the HACCP system either as part of formal qualifications or by the successful completion of formal training based on the principles of the Codex Alimentarius or training in food safety management standards (e.g., ISO 22000, BRCGS, IFS, PHA).
verifica: Training in the HACCP system either as part of formal qualifications or by the successful completion of formal training based on the principles of the Codex Alimentarius or training in food safety management standards (e.g., ISO 22000, BRCGS, IFS, PHA)

campos.label: Formación en higiene de los alimentos, formal o por capacitación completada con éxito.
campos.criterio: Food hygiene training either as part of formal qualifications or by the successful completion of formal training.
verifica: Food hygiene training either as part of formal qualifications or by the successful completion of formal training

campos.label: En plantas: formación en protección vegetal, fertilización y manejo integrado de plagas.
campos.criterio: For plants scope: plant protection, fertilizer, and integrated pest management training, either as part of formal qualifications or through the successful completion of formal training; all formal trainings by specialists on these topics For aquaculture scope: basic veterinary medicine, including animal health and welfare issues
verifica: For plants scope: plant protection, fertilizer, and integrated pest management training, either as part of formal qualifications or through the successful completion of formal training; all formal trainings by specialists on these topics For aquaculture scope: basic veterinary medicine, including animal health and welfare issues

campos.label: Los auditores internos deben tener conocimiento práctico de los productos que auditan.
campos.criterio: In all cases internal auditors shall have practical knowledge about the products they are auditing. Experience may be complemented by trainings on product characteristics and handling operations. These trainings can be done internally.
verifica: In all cases internal auditors shall have practical knowledge about the products they are auditing
Experience may be complemented by trainings on product characteristics and handling operations
These trainings can be done internally

campos.label: El gestor y los auditores deben dominar el idioma de trabajo y su terminología especializada.
campos.criterio: QMS manager and internal auditor(s) shall have “working language” skills in the corresponding native/working language. This shall include locally used specialist terminology in the respective working language.
verifica: QMS manager and internal auditor(s) shall have “working language” skills in the corresponding native/working language
This shall include locally used specialist terminology in the respective working language

campos.label: Las excepciones a la regla de idioma deben aclararse con el OC antes de la auditoría interna.
campos.criterio: Exceptions to this rule shall be clarified beforehand with the CB before the internal audit.
verifica: Exceptions to this rule shall be clarified beforehand with the CB before the internal audit

campos.label: Los auditores internos no pueden auditar su propio trabajo; el SGC asegura su independencia.
campos.criterio: Internal auditors are not allowed to audit their own work. Independence of key staff shall be controlled and ensured by the QMS (i.e., an internal QMS auditor cannot evaluate their own operations or a producer they have also consulted in the last two years, the QMS manager cannot perform QMS audits, etc.).
verifica: Internal auditors are not allowed to audit their own work

Independence of key staff shall be controlled and ensured by the QMS (i.e., an internal QMS auditor cannot evaluate their own operations or a producer they have also consulted in the last two years, the QMS manager cannot perform QMS audits, etc.)

campos.label: El personal clave debe respetar estrictamente los procedimientos de confidencialidad de la información.
campos.criterio: Key staff shall strictly observe the producer group's/multisite producer's procedures for maintaining the confidentiality of information and records.
verifica: Key staff shall strictly observe the producer group's/multisite producer's procedures for maintaining the confidentiality of information and records

campos.label: Define los roles y responsabilidades de los trabajadores que inciden en el estándar.

verifica: The roles and responsibilities of workers whose jobs have an impact on the implementation of the standard are defined

campos.label: Los responsables de decisiones técnicas sobre insumos demuestran competencia.

verifica: Individuals responsible for technical decision-making on inputs can demonstrate competence

campos.label: La capacitación cubre las habilidades necesarias y se respalda con registros.

verifica: Worker training includes the necessary skills and competencies and is supported by records
